title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Product Engineer
description:
Product Engineer (Node.js / React / AdTech) – Contract (6+ Months, Extension Likely)

Location: Remote (EU Time Zones)

Contract Length: 6 months – strong potential for long-term extensions

Start: ASAP

Tech Stack: Node.js, React, APIs, Social/YouTube integrations, AdTech, Creator/UGC discovery


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly experienced Product Engineer to help build a next-generation AdTech platform , supporting categories such as beauty, lifestyle, UGC, and topic-based recommendations for a Euro Retail and Marketing powerhouse.


This contract role sits inside a fast-moving, cross-functional product team building internal tools and white-labelled solutions used across wider business units. You’ll be responsible for scoping, designing, and developing features end-to-end — from backend services to polished, user-friendly front-end experiences.


This is a hands-on build role , perfect for an engineer with strong product instincts and experience delivering consumer-facing or AdTech-driven discovery systems.


Key Responsibilities

Product Engineering & Feature Ownership

  • Build and evolve a creator discovery solution end-to-end using Node.js and React
  • Own product features from concept → prototype → implementation → iteration
  • Work closely with product managers, data teams, and internal partners to define requirements
  • Rapidly test, validate, and iterate on user workflows and ranking experiences


API & Platform Integrations

  • Integrate with social-platform APIs (e.g., YouTube Data API , Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest)
  • Develop services to ingest, enrich, and structure creator data (categories, topics, UGC signals, relevance scoring)
  • Optimise ingestion and discovery pipelines for performance and scale


AdTech & Recommendation Work

  • Build components that support advertising partners, sponsorship matching, and creator-brand fit
  • Implement logic for topic/category classification, recommendation ranking, and metadata structuring
  • Work on internal tools and white-label solutions used by cross-functional teams


Backend & Frontend Engineering

  • Build scalable backend services in Node.js (REST, GraphQL, event-driven services)
  • Develop polished UIs in React , ensuring high usability and clarity for internal teams
  • Ensure strong code quality, automated testing, and reliable CI/CD


Collaboration & Delivery

  • Partner closely with engineering leads, PMs, data scientists, and marketing/AdTech teams
  • Operate in a rapid, iterative environment with short feedback loops
  • Participate in architectural decisions and contribute to long-term platform direction
  • Support a healthy engineering culture focused on velocity, clarity, and product impact


Required Experience

  • 5+ years as a product-focused engineer
  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and React
  • Experience integrating with social media APIs (YouTube essential; Instagram/TikTok/Pinterest a plus)
  • Experience in AdTech, marketing tech, creator platforms, or discovery/recommendation systems
  • Experience building internal tools, dashboards, or white-label solutions
  • Strong product mindset — comfortable owning features, making trade-offs, and shipping iteratively
  • Ability to translate ambiguous ideas into clear technical plans
  • Strong communication, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional collaboration


Nice to Have

  • Experience with video/content metadata (categories, beauty, topics, “lookalike” discovery)
  • Understanding of ranking, scoring, or classification models
  • Background with UGC/creator ecosystems (YouTube creators, UGC workflows, performance marketing)
  • Experience with event-driven microservices or data pipelines
  • GraphQL experience
  • Experience in high-scale consumer-facing platforms


Why This Role?

  • High-impact greenfield project
  • Central to the business’ advertising & creator strategy
  • Autonomy to shape the product and tech direction
  • Flexible remote contract with extensions very likely

title: Gerente de Vendas – Brasil
description:
Título do cargo: Gerente de Vendas – Brasil

Departamento: Vendas – APC, América Latina

Reporta a: Diretor de Vendas, América Latina


Propósito :

Impulsionar o crescimento comercial e técnico dos produtos da APC (plasma, hemácias e outros ingredientes do Grupo Lauridsen) nos mercados de suinocultura, avicultura e aquicultura no Brasil, com foco na geração de demanda, no desenvolvimento de distribuidores, consultores e key accounts.


Responsabilidades:

Estratégia de vendas

  • Liderar e executar o plano de vendas e negócios para a linha de produtos APC no Brasil, alinhado com as metas da APC em nível global.
  • Desenvolver e manter negócios com key accounts, incluindo cooperativas, premixeiras e fábricas de ração. Manter bom relacionamento com os clientes existentes e identificar um forte pipeline de oportunidades.
  • Selecionar / avaliar e nomear novos distribuidores para estados potenciais. Capacidade de gerenciar, motivar e treinar distribuidores.
  • Conhecimento técnico para promover ingredientes especiais e capacidade de demonstrar valor / retorno sobre investimento.
  • Conhecimento prático nas indústrias de Suínos, Aves e Aquicultura no mercado brasileiro. Liderar e impulsionar a ativação de novos negócios e manter bom relacionamento com tomadores de decisão-chave será uma vantagem adicional.
  • Formular estratégias comerciais para atingir as metas acordadas de vendas, margens e gestão de crédito para o Brasil.
  • Implementar o plano estratégico para expandir os negócios da APC no Brasil, incluindo gestão de canais.
  • Negociar preços e manter margens alinhadas aos objetivos regionais e globais.
  • Gestão de produto e planejamento estratégico.
  • Análise de dados para tomada de decisão (disponibilidade, demanda, capacidade).
  • Gerenciar estrategicamente os estoques das fábricas, garantindo eficiência e agilidade frente a diferentes cenários de demanda.
  • Demonstrar boa capacidade de escuta ativa, atendendo de forma eficaz clientes internos e externos.


Estratégia de marketing

  • Implementar o posicionamento adequado dos produtos e definir metas de desenvolvimento focadas para o Brasil.
  • Assegurar um bom entendimento das necessidades dos clientes, das condições de mercado e das atividades dos concorrentes para desenvolver estratégias de produto e de canais.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com time regional e global para obter o suporte necessário.
  • Desenvolver um plano de marketing por meio de anúncios, feiras, seminários, eventos, entre outras atividades.


Requisitos:

Este cargo exige capacidades para aplicar habilidades de negócios e técnicas relacionadas às diferentes aplicações por espécie e ao uso dos produtos. Além disso, o ocupante da posição deve compreender as necessidades do mercado, identificar oportunidades e disseminar informações sobre os produtos, apoiando as áreas técnica e de marketing no desenvolvimento de planos/estratégias para o crescimento do negócio.


Condições de trabalho:

Esta posição exige que o ocupante viaje regularmente a trabalho. Além disso, o titular do cargo passa tempo nos seguintes ambientes: escritórios administrativos, conferências e escritórios de clientes. 

  • A vaga é destinada a cidadãos e residentes no Brasil.
  • Trabalho remoto com disponibilidade para viagens frequentes (40–60% do tempo).
  • Pacote de remuneração competitivo com bônus por desempenho.
  • Suporte regional e conexão com a estrutura técnica/comercial global.


Qualificações:

  • Formação acadêmica em Zootecnia, Medicina Veterinária ou Agronomia, com conhecimento em Gestão de Negócios ou Marketing e paixão pela indústria de nutrição animal.
  • Cerca de 5 a 10 anos de experiência relevante em vendas e marketing na indústria B2B de nutrição animal.
  • Perfil comercial, postura prática e proativa, com boas habilidades de comunicação.
  • Sensibilidade multicultural e fluência em inglês.
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas em suinocultura, avicultura e aquicultura.


Sobre a APC

A APC é líder mundial na produção e comercialização de proteínas sanguíneas derivadas de plasma e hemácias. Nossa história começou em 1981, quando os cientistas da APC descobriram o poderoso papel que as proteínas funcionais derivadas do plasma desempenham em ajudar a apoiar e manter a função imunológica em animais. O negócio pioneiro focado em estudos científicos rendeu mais de 600 artigos publicados em revistas científicas internacionais e mais de uma dúzia de patentes relacionadas à coleta e processamento das proteínas do sangue e do plasma. Hoje, a APC emprega mais de 500 pessoas e opera 17 fábricas em oito países em todo o mundo. A APC continua comprometida com a essência de sua missão de ajudar animais a atingir o melhor desempenho por meio do uso de proteínas funcionais inovadoras que impactam positivamente a saúde animal.

title: ServiceNow Technical Expert
description:
ServiceNow Technical Expert

Organization: BEXIT (Business Excellence & IT Strategy)

Reporting: Reports to Christian Daller, Head of BEXIT

Position Type: Individual Contributor


Role Description:

The ServiceNow Technical Expert will play a pivotal role in building and evolving ServiceNow as the “IT ERP” for the newco IT organization. This individual will take hands-on architectural decisions, guide and supervise external partners in development and application management, and directly contribute to configuration, development, and administration of ServiceNow. The role will consult and guide on architectural and configuration decisions across a broad range of modules—including SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, custom apps, integrations, and more—ensuring ServiceNow meets the needs of a modern, integrated IT landscape.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Make hands-on architectural decisions for ServiceNow configuration and development.
  • Guide and supervise external partners responsible for ServiceNow development and application management.
  • Perform configuration, development, and administration tasks within ServiceNow.
  • Collaborate closely with the DSM ServiceNow, Enterprise Architect, and Process Owners to ensure alignment with strategic roadmaps and project scopes.
  • Investigate and advise on module usage, integrations, and platform capabilities across such as, but not limited to, SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, and custom applications.
  • Ensure platform design follows best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Represent BEXIT as a subject matter expert in cross-functional meetings and initiatives
  • Training: Provide Training regarding ServiceNow stretching from End Users to Technical Staff and Architects.


Expectations:

  • Prioritize out-of-the-box functionality and avoid custom development unless justified by business case, legal, EHS, or security requirements.
  • Follow ServiceNow best practices to ensure scalability, maintainability, and minimal technical debt.
  • Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and consultative guidance across modules.
  • Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure all architectural decisions are aligned with the enterprise roadmap and scoped demands.


Qualifications:

  • Must-Have: ServiceNow Administrator certification or equivalent. Additional certifications in the context of ITIL functionality are beneficial.
  • Proven experience in scripting and integration within ServiceNow.
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
  • Basic knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).


  • Nice-to-Have: Familiarity with architectural frameworks such as CSDM and TOGAF.
  • Experience across multiple ServiceNow modules.
  • Understanding of enterprise IT transformation and ERP-like platform design.


Authorization:

  • Make architectural and configuration decisions within the roadmap provided by the Enterprise Architect and the scope defined by Process Owners and DSMs.
  • Represent BEXIT in cross-functional meetings and initiatives as a subject matter expert (SME).
  • Approve configuration and development work that aligns with best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Guide and supervise external partners in development and application management activities.

title: Infrastructure automation engineer
description:
Title: Infrastructure automation engineer

Location: Remote


The Lead, Infrastructure automation engineer role is part of the Cloud and Compute engineering organisation to drive an improved developer experience and automation first approach for adoption of public and hybrid cloud computing environment in a secured manner. This role will be passionate about developing cloud-agnostic infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management automation, ensuring associated security and compliance guardrails to meet application hosting requirements. The role is foran individual contributor who will develop Terraform, Chef and Python REST API based automation for automated provisioning, change, and decommission of VM, IaaS and PaaS database and Cloud resources in public cloud AWS, Azure, GCP and private cloud.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and enforce CIS security standards for Windows and Linux operating systems using Chef or similar configuration management tools.
  • Deliver new cloud services to the business, while simplifying and improving service consumption and operational management
  • Leverage Python REST APIs to develop “Zero” touch provisioning, patching, change and decommissioning of VM, Kubernetes, PaaS database for lifecycle management of Hybrid Cloud resources.
  • Develop REST APIs in python using BDD methodology and implement public cloud security guardrails.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams for proof of technology in public cloud computing environment.
  • Build Hybrid Cloud infrastructure provisioning workflows leveraging continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines (CI/CD) running on Jenkins and or other CI CD tools.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams and drive resolution of sophisticated technical problems across infrastructure and application stack.
  • Design, engineer, implement Infrastructure As Code with API first and microservices based approach for public cloud service.
  • Leverage internal and external resources to develop, advance and retain talent.
  • Review current processes and find opportunities for automation and build common frameworks in agile manner that cultivate adoption of automation across all layers.
  • Groom Jira features and stories to improve reliability and reduce support incidents for global infrastructure

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in STEM field.
  • 5 years of progressive experience in a combination of development, design in areas of cloud computing and infrastructure engineering.
  • Strong Infrastructure as a Code (IaC) experience on hybrid cloud environment,
  • Observability, through tools such as Prometheus, Elasticsearch, Grafana, DataDog or Zipkin is a plus.
  • 2+ years hands-on experience in Chef or similar config management tool is required
  • 2+ years hands-on experience in AWS, Azure, or GCP is required
  • Experience building Restful APIs is required.
  • 1+ year of Terraform experience.
  • Experience in Kubernetes is preferred
  • VMware experience is preferred.
  • Open-Source virtualization experience like KVM and Ovirt is preferred.
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA Python development experience is preferred but development experience with one or more of the following languages may be acceptable: Go, Scala, Java, Ruby, Python
  • Experience in supporting global operations and following enterprise level process frameworks. Good social, oral and written communication skills are preferred.
  • Self-starter with positive relationship abilities and customer service skills is preferred

title: Analista de Customer Sucess Pleno
description:
Missão do cargo:

Construir uma base sólida para o crescimento sustentável da carteira de clientes do segmento de RH, garantindo que a empresa cliente possa escalar suas operações de RH de maneira eficaz e mantendo a satisfação do cliente com as soluções TOTVS.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Estabelecer relacionamentos sólidos com o departamento de Recursos Humanos e principais stakeholders do cliente, visando entender desafios e oportunidades para direcionar o RH na implementação de processos eficientes através das soluções de folha de pagamento e gestão de ponto eletrônico TOTVS;
  • Responsável pela totalidade da receita recorrente de uma carteira de clientes, atuando proativamente para a adoção de soluções de RH e mitigação do risco churn, assegurando a execução e sucesso na jornada do cliente. É essencial ter autogestão, organização e proatividade;
  • Realizar reuniões estratégicas periódicas com clientes e demais stakeholders, buscando promover um relacionamento parceiro que favoreça o crescimento e a eficácia do negócio através das soluções para RH TOTVS.
  • Conduzir ações que integrem diferentes áreas do cliente e da TOTVS, facilitando o desenvolvimento de projetos e processos. Deve ter adaptabilidade, capacidade de lidar com mudanças em ambientes dinâmicos, além de trabalho em equipe e colaboração;
  • Monitorar periodicamente indicadores de desempenho e métricas de satisfação do cliente; com foco em resultados e na gestão de produtividade e performance de metas;
  • Resiliência ao lidar com resolução de problemas e negociação de demandas;


Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:


Formação: Superior em Recursos Humanos, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;


  • Conhecimento em legislação trabalhista, software de folha de pagamento e ponto eletrônico;
  • Experiência prévia em departamento pessoal e/ou contabilidade, com foco em gestão de processos de ponto eletrônico e folha de pagamento;
  • Capacidade de comunicação, influência e relacionamentos diferentes stakeholders (internos e externos);
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office e/ou Google Workspace;
  • Postura de accountability, senso de dono e visão sistêmica de negócios;
  • Perfil ágil e focado em resultados em meio a cenário multidisciplinar;
  • Habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas demandas com alta organização;


Requisitos desejáveis

SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:


  • Experiência com atendimento.

title: Gerente de Vendas – Brasil
description:
Título do cargo: Gerente de Vendas – Brasil

Departamento: Vendas – APC, América Latina

Reporta a: Diretor de Vendas, América Latina


Propósito :

Impulsionar o crescimento comercial e técnico dos produtos da APC (plasma, hemácias e outros ingredientes do Grupo Lauridsen) nos mercados de suinocultura, avicultura e aquicultura no Brasil, com foco na geração de demanda, no desenvolvimento de distribuidores, consultores e key accounts.


Responsabilidades:

Estratégia de vendas

  • Liderar e executar o plano de vendas e negócios para a linha de produtos APC no Brasil, alinhado com as metas da APC em nível global.
  • Desenvolver e manter negócios com key accounts, incluindo cooperativas, premixeiras e fábricas de ração. Manter bom relacionamento com os clientes existentes e identificar um forte pipeline de oportunidades.
  • Selecionar / avaliar e nomear novos distribuidores para estados potenciais. Capacidade de gerenciar, motivar e treinar distribuidores.
  • Conhecimento técnico para promover ingredientes especiais e capacidade de demonstrar valor / retorno sobre investimento.
  • Conhecimento prático nas indústrias de Suínos, Aves e Aquicultura no mercado brasileiro. Liderar e impulsionar a ativação de novos negócios e manter bom relacionamento com tomadores de decisão-chave será uma vantagem adicional.
  • Formular estratégias comerciais para atingir as metas acordadas de vendas, margens e gestão de crédito para o Brasil.
  • Implementar o plano estratégico para expandir os negócios da APC no Brasil, incluindo gestão de canais.
  • Negociar preços e manter margens alinhadas aos objetivos regionais e globais.
  • Gestão de produto e planejamento estratégico.
  • Análise de dados para tomada de decisão (disponibilidade, demanda, capacidade).
  • Gerenciar estrategicamente os estoques das fábricas, garantindo eficiência e agilidade frente a diferentes cenários de demanda.
  • Demonstrar boa capacidade de escuta ativa, atendendo de forma eficaz clientes internos e externos.


Estratégia de marketing

  • Implementar o posicionamento adequado dos produtos e definir metas de desenvolvimento focadas para o Brasil.
  • Assegurar um bom entendimento das necessidades dos clientes, das condições de mercado e das atividades dos concorrentes para desenvolver estratégias de produto e de canais.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com time regional e global para obter o suporte necessário.
  • Desenvolver um plano de marketing por meio de anúncios, feiras, seminários, eventos, entre outras atividades.


Requisitos:

Este cargo exige capacidades para aplicar habilidades de negócios e técnicas relacionadas às diferentes aplicações por espécie e ao uso dos produtos. Além disso, o ocupante da posição deve compreender as necessidades do mercado, identificar oportunidades e disseminar informações sobre os produtos, apoiando as áreas técnica e de marketing no desenvolvimento de planos/estratégias para o crescimento do negócio.


Condições de trabalho:

Esta posição exige que o ocupante viaje regularmente a trabalho. Além disso, o titular do cargo passa tempo nos seguintes ambientes: escritórios administrativos, conferências e escritórios de clientes. 

  • A vaga é destinada a cidadãos e residentes no Brasil.
  • Trabalho remoto com disponibilidade para viagens frequentes (40–60% do tempo).
  • Pacote de remuneração competitivo com bônus por desempenho.
  • Suporte regional e conexão com a estrutura técnica/comercial global.


Qualificações:

  • Formação acadêmica em Zootecnia, Medicina Veterinária ou Agronomia, com conhecimento em Gestão de Negócios ou Marketing e paixão pela indústria de nutrição animal.
  • Cerca de 5 a 10 anos de experiência relevante em vendas e marketing na indústria B2B de nutrição animal.
  • Perfil comercial, postura prática e proativa, com boas habilidades de comunicação.
  • Sensibilidade multicultural e fluência em inglês.
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas em suinocultura, avicultura e aquicultura.


Sobre a APC

A APC é líder mundial na produção e comercialização de proteínas sanguíneas derivadas de plasma e hemácias. Nossa história começou em 1981, quando os cientistas da APC descobriram o poderoso papel que as proteínas funcionais derivadas do plasma desempenham em ajudar a apoiar e manter a função imunológica em animais. O negócio pioneiro focado em estudos científicos rendeu mais de 600 artigos publicados em revistas científicas internacionais e mais de uma dúzia de patentes relacionadas à coleta e processamento das proteínas do sangue e do plasma. Hoje, a APC emprega mais de 500 pessoas e opera 17 fábricas em oito países em todo o mundo. A APC continua comprometida com a essência de sua missão de ajudar animais a atingir o melhor desempenho por meio do uso de proteínas funcionais inovadoras que impactam positivamente a saúde animal.

title: Infrastructure automation engineer
description:
Title: Infrastructure automation engineer

Location: Remote


The Lead, Infrastructure automation engineer role is part of the Cloud and Compute engineering organisation to drive an improved developer experience and automation first approach for adoption of public and hybrid cloud computing environment in a secured manner. This role will be passionate about developing cloud-agnostic infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management automation, ensuring associated security and compliance guardrails to meet application hosting requirements. The role is foran individual contributor who will develop Terraform, Chef and Python REST API based automation for automated provisioning, change, and decommission of VM, IaaS and PaaS database and Cloud resources in public cloud AWS, Azure, GCP and private cloud.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and enforce CIS security standards for Windows and Linux operating systems using Chef or similar configuration management tools.
  • Deliver new cloud services to the business, while simplifying and improving service consumption and operational management
  • Leverage Python REST APIs to develop “Zero” touch provisioning, patching, change and decommissioning of VM, Kubernetes, PaaS database for lifecycle management of Hybrid Cloud resources.
  • Develop REST APIs in python using BDD methodology and implement public cloud security guardrails.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams for proof of technology in public cloud computing environment.

title: ServiceNow Technical Expert
description:
ServiceNow Technical Expert

Organization: BEXIT (Business Excellence & IT Strategy)

Reporting: Reports to Christian Daller, Head of BEXIT

Position Type: Individual Contributor


Role Description:

The ServiceNow Technical Expert will play a pivotal role in building and evolving ServiceNow as the “IT ERP” for the newco IT organization. This individual will take hands-on architectural decisions, guide and supervise external partners in development and application management, and directly contribute to configuration, development, and administration of ServiceNow. The role will consult and guide on architectural and configuration decisions across a broad range of modules—including SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, custom apps, integrations, and more—ensuring ServiceNow meets the needs of a modern, integrated IT landscape.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Make hands-on architectural decisions for ServiceNow configuration and development.
  • Guide and supervise external partners responsible for ServiceNow development and application management.
  • Perform configuration, development, and administration tasks within ServiceNow.
  • Collaborate closely with the DSM ServiceNow, Enterprise Architect, and Process Owners to ensure alignment with strategic roadmaps and project scopes.
  • Investigate and advise on module usage, integrations, and platform capabilities across such as, but not limited to, SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, and custom applications.
  • Ensure platform design follows best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Represent BEXIT as a subject matter expert in cross-functional meetings and initiatives
  • Training: Provide Training regarding ServiceNow stretching from End Users to Technical Staff and Architects.


Expectations:

  • Prioritize out-of-the-box functionality and avoid custom development unless justified by business case, legal, EHS, or security requirements.
  • Follow ServiceNow best practices to ensure scalability, maintainability, and minimal technical debt.
  • Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and consultative guidance across modules.
  • Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure all architectural decisions are aligned with the enterprise roadmap and scoped demands.


Qualifications:

  • Must-Have: ServiceNow Administrator certification or equivalent. Additional certifications in the context of ITIL functionality are beneficial.
  • Proven experience in scripting and integration within ServiceNow.
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
  • Basic knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).


  • Nice-to-Have: Familiarity with architectural frameworks such as CSDM and TOGAF.
  • Experience across multiple ServiceNow modules.
  • Understanding of enterprise IT transformation and ERP-like platform design.


Authorization:

  • Make architectural and configuration decisions within the roadmap provided by the Enterprise Architect and the scope defined by Process Owners and DSMs.
  • Represent BEXIT in cross-functional meetings and initiatives as a subject matter expert (SME).
  • Approve configuration and development work that aligns with best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Guide and supervise external partners in development and application management activities.

title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (React.js / Python)
description:

You will join our clients' innovative, growing team on a mission to unleash the power of culture for growing organizational brands at a time of global, seismic cultural transformation.

You will participate in the complete software development process from conception to deployment of our clients ' world-class data and insights platform. You will work closely with product and UX leads, providing a critical voice in solutioning complex workflows and user experiences.

  • Write effective APIs
  • Test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade software
  • Create security and data protection settings
  • Build features and applications with a mobile-responsive design

  • 1+ years of Python experience

  • Great attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and an analytical mind
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with DataViz

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.


What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications in relevant conferences/journals


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Trade Compliance Analyst
description:
Job Title: Regulatory Research Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


Overview

We are seeking an experienced Regulatory Research Analyst to join the Tax & Regulations team of a global independent support provider. This fully remote role focuses on researching and tracking global trade regulations —primarily across LATAM and North America—and contributing insights that help keep SAP GTS systems up to date for global clients. The analyst will act as the first point of contact for new legal and regulatory changes and work closely with Business Analysts and ERP/GTS specialists. Client interaction is minimal; the role is primarily research-oriented.


Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Research & Analysis

  • Monitor and maintain up-to-date awareness of legislative and regulatory changes in assigned countries using government websites, agencies, third-party sources, and in-country experts.
  • Track global trade compliance regulations, including customs duties, export controls, sanctions, tariff updates , and other relevant requirements across jurisdictions (U.S., Canada, LATAM, etc.).
  • Interpret, analyze, and document new or amended legislation in an internal repository with high accuracy and clarity.
  • Prepare comparative analyses of regulatory changes when required.
  • Ensure research and documentation meet ISO process standards .

SAP GTS Alignment

Research and provide insights relevant to SAP GTS (v11 or similar), supporting product specialists on topics such as:

  • Export Control & Licensing
  • Import Control & Market Access
  • Sanctions & Restricted Party Compliance
  • Customs & Tariff Management
  • Trade Agreements & Origin Management
  • Regulatory Reporting & Declarations
  • Product & Classification Compliance

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Deliver clear summaries and detailed regulatory insights needed by ERP and product specialists to implement system changes for clients.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and fellow researchers to validate findings and maintain consistency.
  • Support research expansion into Indirect Tax topics (VAT, GST, country-specific filing requirements) where applicable.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bilingual: English + one LATAM language (Spanish or Portuguese) .
  • 5+ years of professional experience in tax, global trade, or international regulatory research.
  • Working knowledge of SAP GTS or similar trade compliance systems.
  • Familiarity with international trade laws and frameworks (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual Use, WCO, etc.).
  • Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and handle multiple tasks under pressure.
  • Strong internet-based research capabilities and proficiency in business applications (Microsoft Office, Google tools, SharePoint, etc.).
  • Experience compiling complex regulatory information into clear, actionable summaries.
  • Technical understanding of SAP ERP tax/accounting workflows (advantageous, not mandatory).
  • Familiarity with tools like Excel, PDF generation, ABBYY FineReader, Deepl, Inoreader, Beyond Compare (training provided).
  • Self-starter with strong initiative, resourcefulness, and team-oriented mindset.
  • Additional background in finance or tax is a plus.


Why Join Us?

  • Work remotely while contributing to high-impact global compliance research.
  • Collaborate with a diverse international team of trade and tax experts.
  • Play a key role in helping global clients stay compliant with rapidly evolving regulations.

The Opportunity

Grass Valley’s FPGA Engineers develop state-of-the -art solutions for content creation, transmission, and distribution. We are dedicated to redefining the way audiences experience entertainment and information through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced FPGA Engineer specializing in Broadcast Video and Audio to join our team. As a FPGA Engineer, you will be instrumental in the design, development, testing and implementation of FPGA-based solutions specifically tailored for broadcast video and audio applications. Your responsibilities will encompass leading FPGA architecture design, electronic and PCB design and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions into our broadcast systems.


Your Role

  • Lead the architecture, design, and development of FPGA-based systems for broadcast video and audio applications, focusing on Embedded System hardware and electronic design;
  • Optimize FPGA designs to enhance video processing, audio synchronization and develop electronic systems with FPGA architectures;
  • Conduct thorough simulation, testing, debugging, and verification of FPGA designs to ensure seamless functionality and adherence to industry standards;
  • Maintain and improve FPGA build processes using CI/CD tools like Jenkins;

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition


Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.


At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance,  it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.


We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ. This is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.


What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Financial Cents to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.


What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Financial Cents or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.


The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.


Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

description:

title: Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Credit Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical, organized, and hands-on professional with strong leadership skills to coordinate the areas of Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit . This is a strategic position with a structured career path toward a Finance Manager role within up to 18 months , based on performance.

Key Responsibilities

Treasury

  • Prepare and monitor daily, weekly, and projected cash flow;
  • Manage bank accounts, balances, reconciliations, and financial investments;
  • Plan fund transfers between SPVs (SPEs) and partners;
  • Support Controllership with monthly close and cash flow projections;
  • Ensure banking security, proper segregation of duties, and approval levels.

Accounts Payable

  • Coordinate the full payment cycle (review, approval, and execution);
  • Ensure accurate posting of invoices, tax withholdings, and cost centers;
  • Implement and maintain payment policies;
  • Control due dates for contracts, insurance policies, and recurring expenses;
  • Monitor advances, corporate credit cards, and payment exceptions;
  • Support financial automation initiatives and accounting integration.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Coordinate billing (rent, charges, fees, and services);
  • Monitor delinquency, aging reports, collections, and postings in the ERP;
  • Implement preventive and corrective collection policies;
  • Support negotiations with customers and legal teams when required;
  • Develop management reports by property/project.

Credit

  • Implement and continuously review the company’s credit policy;
  • Perform customer financial and credit analysis;
  • Classify customers according to risk levels;
  • Monitor delinquency indicators and credit performance;
  • Train commercial and operational teams on credit rules and processes.

Management & Strategy

  • Develop financial dashboards and performance indicators;
  • Lead continuous improvement and automation projects;
  • Act as the financial interface with partners, funds, and investors;
  • Conduct performance evaluations, develop successors, and build future leaders;
  • Act strategically alongside Controllership and Executive Management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or related fields;
  • Solid experience in Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit;
  • Experience working with financial ERP systems;
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills;
  • Leadership profile with autonomy and strategic mindset;
  • English proficiency is a plus (reading and speaking).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the real estate sector;
  • Experience managing financial flows between SPVs (SPEs);
  • Proven experience implementing financial automation.

What We Offer

  • Clear and structured career path toward a Finance Manager position;
  • Strong technical and strategic development environment;
  • Direct exposure to business financial decision-making.

title: Annotation Specialist
description:
Job Title: Bounding Box Annotation Specialist

Location : Remote

End Date : 1-Jan-2026


Role Summary: Join a high-volume image annotation initiative to ensure high-quality bounding boxes and labels for visual elements like logos, text, and objects. You’ll validate spatial accuracy, correct captions, and ensure consistency across matched image pairs.


This is a completely work-from-home opportunity. This position requires a commitment of 6–8 hours per day , and the compensation offered is $4 per hour .

Please note that you will need to have your own laptop/desktop along with a stable internet connection to perform the tasks effectively.

To move forward, we request you to complete the assessment using the link below.

Kindly ensure you take the test only from a laptop/desktop , as mobile devices are not supported.

Upon clearing the assessment, we will proceed with your onboarding at the earliest.


Key Responsibilities

● Review and adjust bounding boxes (±5 px tolerance).

● Add missing boxes, remove incorrect ones, and refi ne captions.

● Classify elements by object type and ensure transcriptions are correct.

● Match common objects between images using consistent object IDs.

● Maintain high standards of precision and quality across complex image sets.

Requirements

● Attention to spatial detail and object recognition.

● Experience using bounding box tools or visual annotation platforms.

● B1+ English profi ciency to understand and correct object labels/text.

● Familiarity with cross-image matching (assigning IDs).

● Device: Laptop/Desktop, minimum screen size 14″; resolution 1366x768+ (FHD preferred).

title: Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
Position Summary

We are looking for a Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist to join a fast-growing real estate startup in the U.S. This is a hybrid role that combines helpdesk support, HubSpot operations, outbound sales assistance, and light marketing support.

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing support tickets, excellent communication skills, deep familiarity with HubSpot, and the ability to multitask across customer support, RevOps, and sales processes in a fast-paced startup environment.


Key Responsibilities

Customer Support & Helpdesk (40–50%)

  • Serve as the primary responder for inbound support tickets from users.
  • Monitor, triage, and resolve issues through HubSpot Service Hub.
  • Maintain strong response/resolution times with empathetic, professional communication.
  • Document common issues and build internal resources or playbooks.


HubSpot Operations & Administration (20–25%)

  • Manage and optimize workflows, pipelines, automations, and ticket management across HubSpot.
  • Maintain data accuracy for contacts, deals, and support tickets.
  • Support setup and QA of new sequences, processes, and automation in HubSpot.
  • Pull basic reports on sales activity, ticket volume, and marketing performance.


Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting (20–25%)

  • Execute outbound email campaigns and sequences targeting prospects such as real estate agents or brokers.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads following defined playbooks.
  • Set calls and demos for the sales team.
  • Track all activities and updates inside HubSpot.


Marketing Support (5–10%)

  • Assist with email marketing campaigns, list building, and segmentation.
  • Support basic digital marketing tasks as needed.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of customer support or helpdesk experience (B2B SaaS experience preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including:
  • Service/Operations Hub (tickets, workflows, automation)
  • Sales Hub (pipelines, deals, sequences, tasks)
  • Proven success managing support tickets as a core responsibility.
  • Experience supporting outbound sales workflows, sequences, and appointment setting.
  • Familiarity with email marketing or digital campaign support.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with shifting demands.
  • Availability to work 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM MST .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in real estate or PropTech industries.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, ClickUp, and Canva.
  • Experience building support documentation, macros, or knowledge base articles.
  • Track record of improving support metrics or boosting outbound meeting conversions.


What We Offer

  • Fully Remote Position! Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and skill development.
  • Take Your Local Holidays: We respect your cultural and personal commitments.
  • Impact: Join a mission-driven U.S. startup where your work directly enhances customer experience and revenue operations.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
QAT Global – 100% Remote (Brazil Only – CLT hire)

QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is seeking highly-skilled Java Full-Stack Developers with strong English communication skills to join our global engineering team. You will collaborate directly with our US-based customer and work with distributed development teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.


About the Role


As a Java Full-Stack Developer, you will be responsible for building mission-critical backend services and front-end components that support a large-scale financial platform. You will work across domains involving profiles, billing, ledger, invoicing, and payment flows, contributing to both core business logic and customer-facing UI experiences.

This role requires strong expertise in modern full-stack engineering combined with practical experience using AI-assisted development workflows , LLMs, and prompt engineering to accelerate delivery while maintaining high quality.


Responsibilities


  • Develop and maintain backend services across key financial modules (Profile, Billing, Ledger, Invoice, Recurring, Receipt, Remittance).
  • Build and enhance front-end components used in the Administration UI and Payment Widget.
  • Implement business logic, domain models, API endpoints, and cross-service integrations.
  • Work with frameworks defined by the architecture team (likely Java/Kotlin on the backend, TypeScript/React on the frontend).
  • Collaborate closely with QA engineers to ensure functional completeness and application stability.
  • Use AI-assisted workflows to generate code, improve documentation, and create automated tests.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies and work effectively with distributed teams.


Required Experience


  • Strong hands-on experience with Java (Spring Boot) , Node.js , and React .
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and relational data modeling.
  • Familiarity with Security / DevOps / Cloud practices.
  • Knowledge of GitHub CI/CD pipelines , versioning, and workflow automation.
  • Practical usage of GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL, secret scanning, dependency checks).
  • Experience with AWS IAM (roles, policies, permission boundaries).
  • Experience deploying or maintaining workloads on EC2 , RDS , and SQS .
  • Working knowledge of LLM capabilities applied to software development (code generation, code review, refactoring, writing automated tests, requirement analysis).
  • Experience with Claude Sonnet 4.5 or willingness to learn quickly.
  • Ability to apply prompt engineering techniques to:
  • debug and reason about code
  • generate high-quality and consistent implementations
  • enforce architectural patterns and constraints
  • interpret technical and business requirements
  • Understanding of safe and responsible AI usage, including hallucination mitigation, validation steps, and code verification.
  • Basic familiarity with AI-powered IDEs (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, JetBrains AI Assistant, etc.).


Preferred Qualifications


  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent fields.

title: Network Operations Center Technician
description:
Required Skills & Experience


  • 5 years experience troubleshooting DWDM Networks
  • 3 years experience with Ciena 6500 /Infinera/Alcatel PSS-32/16 required
  • 3 years experience in a network operations role required.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


  • Experience working in the field as a Fiber Technician


Job Description


A large telecommunications company is looking for a candidate that will be responsible for maintaining the stability and reliability of network services through advanced technical expertise and proactive coordination. The role includes performing complex troubleshooting and diagnostics, creating and deploying maintenance requests for after-hours network augments, and collaborating with the Network Control Center, Technical Assistance Center, and external vendors to ensure the health of priority circuits. Key duties involve monitoring network operations, conducting remote and off-net testing, managing escalations, and coordinating repair activities by dispatching field technicians and providing timely updates to customers. The position also requires gathering and analyzing network data, creating and executing scripts for repetitive tasks, and identifying automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency.

title: Data Research Analyst
description:
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 3-5 years of data analysis and reporting experience
  • Advanced experience writing and creating large-scale surveys (QuestionPro, Qualtrics), analyzing results/data, and developing actionable findings
  • Experience with Tableau for data visualization
  • Experience in writing detailed reports and presenting data findings/analysis.

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Passion for video games/gaming in order to assist in writing and interpreting survey questions
  • Experience with SQL writing data queries
  • Snowflake or Data Bricks experience


Insight Global is hiring a Data Research Analyst to support the User Experience Research team at a leading company in the Gaming industry. The main role of the Data Research Analyst will be to create, send, and analyze large-scale surveys intended to learn about the player base of the core gaming products.

Job Functions

-Create surveys and trackers to support all products and initiatives

  • Design questions that do not bias respondents
  • Use best practice methodologies to produce actionable, accurate, and representative data.

-Advanced, survey focused, data visualizations (Tableau, Excel, Sheets)

  • Creating clear reports and dashboards based on surveys sent to players and users of their products.

-Data queries (HIVE, Snowflake, Tableau)

  • Querying multiple types of databases and plugging data queries directly into tools like Tableau are essential for this role. These skills will be used to target audiences for survey sends, pull in additional analytics to identify respondents, and allow for advanced data visualizations.

-Report writing and presenting data

  • Writing detailed and understandable reports that will speak to a variety of audiences across the enterprise
  • Presenting data in meetings and providing additional relevant context where applicable.

-Act as backup for all functions of current data researchers

-Provide support to UX researchers on report creation that involves data visualization.

-Quickly pivot with new data to ensure a constant flow of player insights are output as updated player survey data is received to ensure we are always reporting on timely and relevant findings.

-Contribute to overall needs of the UXR team e.g. peer review, supporting other teams with survey expertise, etc.

-Contribute survey expertise to assist others in the company with the creation of surveys.

title: GenAI Fullstack Engineer
description:
Job Title: Full Stack Engineer – GenAI Product Development

Duration : Contract

Location : Remote

Department : Engineering / AI Solutions


About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Engineer to join our dynamic team focused on building custom GenAI products, including workflow automation tools like N8n. This role is ideal for someone passionate about cutting-edge AI technologies and eager to contribute to fast-paced, experimental product development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications with a focus on GenAI integrations.
  • Build scalable frontend interfaces using modern frameworks (e.g., React).

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across global locations in agile environments.

  • Strong understanding of API design, data integration, and microservices architecture.
  • Comfortable working in agile teams and adapting to evolving requirements.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.

Required Skills & Experience


  • 5 years experience troubleshooting DWDM Networks
  • 3 years experience with Ciena 6500 /Infinera/Alcatel PSS-32/16 required
  • 3 years experience in a network operations role required.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


  • Experience working in the field as a Fiber Technician


Job Description


A large telecommunications company is looking for a candidate that will be responsible for maintaining the stability and reliability of network services through advanced technical expertise and proactive coordination. The role includes performing complex troubleshooting and diagnostics, creating and deploying maintenance requests for after-hours network augments, and collaborating with the Network Control Center, Technical Assistance Center, and external vendors to ensure the health of priority circuits. Key duties involve monitoring network operations, conducting remote and off-net testing, managing escalations, and coordinating repair activities by dispatching field technicians and providing timely updates to customers. The position also requires gathering and analyzing network data, creating and executing scripts for repetitive tasks, and identifying automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency.

title: Dotnet Developer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior .NET Developer with AWS experience to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services with over 300,000 team members in nearly 50 countries. The end client is in the quick serve restaurants industry.


Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil .


Working hours: Pacific Time Zone . You will be required to follow the client's time zone.


MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.


Responsibilities :

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable applications using .NET in an AWS environment, and related technologies.
  • Develop and maintain back-end applications using ASP.NET, Web APIs, etc.
  • Integrate third-party services and APIs into internal applications
  • Ensure high-quality code by writing automated tests, performing code reviews, and adhering to best practices


Requirements:

  • Must have at least 10+ years of IT experience
  • Strong understanding of .NET Core and Web APIs , along with knowledge of AWS.
  • Proficient in C#, with experience building backend services (.NET framework)
  • Hands on experience in AWS environments (Azure is a plus)
  • The client expects the developer to have a very good understanding of AWS features and tools such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, EKS, Kubernetes , etc.
  • Experience supporting an integration and transformation platforms between internal systems and external vendor systems, especially those involving complex business logic.
  • Azure : Having knowledge in this area would be a bonus
  • Understanding of the QSR (fast food) industry : This is also considered a plus.
  • Good Understanding of OAuth and webhooks
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Experience of working in a Agile environment

title: Suporte técnico
description:

Buscamos profissionais de diferentes níveis para atuar no suporte técnico, garantindo atendimento aos usuários, continuidade dos serviços e apoio às equipes internas. Procuramos pessoas analíticas, comunicativas e orientadas à solução.

  • Realizar análises iniciais, tratativas técnicas e troubleshooting.

  • Documentar procedimentos e contribuir para a base de conhecimento.

  • Sinalizar incidentes recorrentes e apoiar melhorias operacionais.

  • Ferramentas ITSM (ServiceNow, Jira, GLPI, Remedy, Freshservice).

  • Rotinas operacionais, monitoramento e análise de indicadores.

title: Executivo de Negócios
description:
Você será responsável por abrir portas com empresários e decisores nos setores estratégicos da Karizoda — tanto no Brasil quanto nos Estados Unidos — atuando como hunter de alta performance e closer estratégico em vendas consultivas.


Mais do que vender serviços, seu papel será vender visão, diagnóstico e resultado . Isso exige habilidade para criar conexões em ambientes frios, gerar autoridade em contextos desafiadores e manter controle sobre um ciclo de vendas que envolve múltiplas etapas, personas e canais.


Buscamos um(a) profissional de mercado, com inglês fluente, experiência em vendas consultivas de growth ou produtos de marketing. Com capacidade para construção, implementação de processos e fechamento de vendas.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:


  • Prospecção ativa (hunter real).
  • Pesquisa e identificação de leads estratégicos.
  • Construção de cadências de cold email, cold call e social selling.
  • Extração de leads de comunidades como G4 e C12 com cadências segmentadas.
  • Condução completa da jornada do lead.
  • Realizar abordagens frias com copy inteligente e contextual.
  • Agendar e conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico com foco em venda consultiva.
  • Personalizar propostas e apresentações com base nos desafios do cliente.
  • Fechamento de contratos e acompanhamento do pipeline.
  • Trabalhar em CRM de forma disciplinada (nada de “controle paralelo”).
  • Garantir follow-ups com inteligência e senso de urgência.
  • Atuar com metas claras de reuniões, propostas enviadas e contratos fechados.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com marketing para retroalimentar os dados de personas.
  • Contribuir com feedbacks sobre objeções, ICPs e canais mais eficazes.
  • Participar da evolução do playbook comercial junto à liderança.
  • Atuar com o mercado nacional e internacional, principalmente EUA.
  • Apoiar a liderança no planejamento estratégico de abertura de novos mercados, desde as etapas de pesquisa até a implementação de novos funis de prospecção, processos de vendas e fechamentos, assim como a tomada de decisões estratégicas relacionadas à área Comercial.


REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS


Imprescindíveis:


  • Formação superior em Administração, Marketing, Vendas, Comunicação ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência real com prospecção fria multicanal (cold call, email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp).
  • Domínio de CRM (HubSpot ou similares) e ferramentas de sales intelligence.
  • Inglês fluente (nível avançado para calls comerciais).
  • Autonomia para gerar resultados com ritmo e organização.


Desejáveis:

  • Experiência prévia vendendo para os EUA ou tendo atuado em ambientes globais.
  • Familiaridade com vendas em comunidades, redes de relacionamento e eventos (ex.: G4, C12, grupos setoriais).
  • Vivência com produtos e serviços de marketing, growth ou tecnologia.


REQUISITOS COMPORTAMENTAIS:

  • Forte inteligência emocional, capaz de lidar com conflitos internos e externos, agindo com maturidade com foco em resultados;
  • Habilidade em dar e receber feedback, reconhecendo os erros com humildade, buscando ações que apresentem soluções práticas e rápidas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e influência.
  • Proatividade, organização e capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão.
  • Discrição e confiabilidade – Essencial para lidar com informações sensíveis da empresa;
  • Autonomia e autorresponsabilidade: Capacidade de tomar decisões de forma estruturada e eficiente.


O QUE OFERECEMOS:


  • Ambiente de Trabalho: 100% remoto, pautado em autonomia e confiança;
  • Modelo de Contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ);
  • Day off de aniversário: Um dia de folga no seu aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado: 15 dias anuais de recesso;
  • Bonificação por tempo de contrato.
  • Faixa contratual (PJ): R$ 4.500,00 a R$ 6.000,00 fixo mensal + variável. (o valor final será definido com base na avaliação das soft skills, habilidades técnicas (hard skills) e na experiência comprovada do(a) candidato(a)).
