title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Senior Full-Stack Web Application Developer with 7+ years of experience producing commercial-grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities, an aptitude for learning new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The company's solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit from the automation of the most complex business processes, reducing operating costs, saving time, and increasing profitability through reporting, analytics, and decision-support systems once exclusive to major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance legacy application - JavaScript frontend and PHP backend running on Linux, nginx (engine x), fpm, and mostly MySQL
  • Modernize software solution using React.js and/or Vue.js design, architect, develop, deliver, and sustain
  • Take technical ownership of features and their impact on the business - assist with refining functional and technical specifications
  • Deliver product features and updates with minimal direction, yet know when to seek help to remain efficient
  • Review and approve pull requests from less senior developers and assure alignment with established best practices
  • Build and execute unit tests
  • Interact with end-users/customers to ensure smooth deployments and to understand needs/issues
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Display comprehensive understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), as applied to projects of increasing size and complexity, with emphasis on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • Analysis and design
  • Estimating
  • Planning

  • Excellent English communication skills

  • Prior success as a senior developer coaching less skilled/experienced developers, establishing coding guidelines/best practices, and reviewing pull requests

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer (Webflow + WordPress)
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.



What You’ll Do


  • Design and develop responsive, visually engaging websites in Webflow and WordPress .
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Translate approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow or WordPress.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Ensure all designs follow UX/UI best practices , accessibility standards, and performance guidelines.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Webflow/WordPress capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.


What You Bring


  • 3+ years of professional experience designing AND developing websites using Webflow and WordPress .
  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds .
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS , and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.



Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.



Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST , Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Trade Compliance Analyst
description:
Job Title: Regulatory Research Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


Overview

We are seeking an experienced Regulatory Research Analyst to join the Tax & Regulations team of a global independent support provider. This fully remote role focuses on researching and tracking global trade regulations —primarily across LATAM and North America—and contributing insights that help keep SAP GTS systems up to date for global clients. The analyst will act as the first point of contact for new legal and regulatory changes and work closely with Business Analysts and ERP/GTS specialists. Client interaction is minimal; the role is primarily research-oriented.


Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Research & Analysis

  • Monitor and maintain up-to-date awareness of legislative and regulatory changes in assigned countries using government websites, agencies, third-party sources, and in-country experts.
  • Track global trade compliance regulations, including customs duties, export controls, sanctions, tariff updates , and other relevant requirements across jurisdictions (U.S., Canada, LATAM, etc.).
  • Interpret, analyze, and document new or amended legislation in an internal repository with high accuracy and clarity.
  • Prepare comparative analyses of regulatory changes when required.
  • Ensure research and documentation meet ISO process standards .

SAP GTS Alignment

Research and provide insights relevant to SAP GTS (v11 or similar), supporting product specialists on topics such as:

  • Export Control & Licensing
  • Import Control & Market Access
  • Sanctions & Restricted Party Compliance
  • Customs & Tariff Management
  • Trade Agreements & Origin Management
  • Regulatory Reporting & Declarations
  • Product & Classification Compliance

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Deliver clear summaries and detailed regulatory insights needed by ERP and product specialists to implement system changes for clients.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and fellow researchers to validate findings and maintain consistency.
  • Support research expansion into Indirect Tax topics (VAT, GST, country-specific filing requirements) where applicable.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bilingual: English + one LATAM language (Spanish or Portuguese) .
  • 5+ years of professional experience in tax, global trade, or international regulatory research.
  • Working knowledge of SAP GTS or similar trade compliance systems.
  • Familiarity with international trade laws and frameworks (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual Use, WCO, etc.).
  • Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and handle multiple tasks under pressure.
  • Strong internet-based research capabilities and proficiency in business applications (Microsoft Office, Google tools, SharePoint, etc.).
  • Experience compiling complex regulatory information into clear, actionable summaries.
  • Technical understanding of SAP ERP tax/accounting workflows (advantageous, not mandatory).
  • Familiarity with tools like Excel, PDF generation, ABBYY FineReader, Deepl, Inoreader, Beyond Compare (training provided).
  • Self-starter with strong initiative, resourcefulness, and team-oriented mindset.

title: Trade Compliance Analyst
description:
Job Title: Regulatory Research Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


Overview

We are seeking an experienced Regulatory Research Analyst to join the Tax & Regulations team of a global independent support provider. This fully remote role focuses on researching and tracking global trade regulations —primarily across LATAM and North America—and contributing insights that help keep SAP GTS systems up to date for global clients. The analyst will act as the first point of contact for new legal and regulatory changes and work closely with Business Analysts and ERP/GTS specialists. Client interaction is minimal; the role is primarily research-oriented.


Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Research & Analysis

  • Monitor and maintain up-to-date awareness of legislative and regulatory changes in assigned countries using government websites, agencies, third-party sources, and in-country experts.
  • Track global trade compliance regulations, including customs duties, export controls, sanctions, tariff updates , and other relevant requirements across jurisdictions (U.S., Canada, LATAM, etc.).
  • Interpret, analyze, and document new or amended legislation in an internal repository with high accuracy and clarity.
  • Prepare comparative analyses of regulatory changes when required.
  • Ensure research and documentation meet ISO process standards .

SAP GTS Alignment

Research and provide insights relevant to SAP GTS (v11 or similar), supporting product specialists on topics such as:

  • Export Control & Licensing
  • Import Control & Market Access
  • Sanctions & Restricted Party Compliance
  • Customs & Tariff Management
  • Trade Agreements & Origin Management
  • Regulatory Reporting & Declarations
  • Product & Classification Compliance

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Deliver clear summaries and detailed regulatory insights needed by ERP and product specialists to implement system changes for clients.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and fellow researchers to validate findings and maintain consistency.
  • Support research expansion into Indirect Tax topics (VAT, GST, country-specific filing requirements) where applicable.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bilingual: English + one LATAM language (Spanish or Portuguese) .
  • 5+ years of professional experience in tax, global trade, or international regulatory research.
  • Working knowledge of SAP GTS or similar trade compliance systems.
  • Familiarity with international trade laws and frameworks (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual Use, WCO, etc.).
  • Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and handle multiple tasks under pressure.
  • Strong internet-based research capabilities and proficiency in business applications (Microsoft Office, Google tools, SharePoint, etc.).
  • Experience compiling complex regulatory information into clear, actionable summaries.
  • Technical understanding of SAP ERP tax/accounting workflows (advantageous, not mandatory).
  • Familiarity with tools like Excel, PDF generation, ABBYY FineReader, Deepl, Inoreader, Beyond Compare (training provided).
  • Self-starter with strong initiative, resourcefulness, and team-oriented mindset.
  • Additional background in finance or tax is a plus.


Why Join Us?

  • Work remotely while contributing to high-impact global compliance research.
  • Collaborate with a diverse international team of trade and tax experts.
  • Play a key role in helping global clients stay compliant with rapidly evolving regulations.

title: Content Writer (Portuguese) - 53457
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Content Writer to create and refine content used in workflows, training data, and scenario-based evaluations for large language models (LLMs). You will help build realistic content samples, review AI-generated outputs, and ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create and edit content across formats such as articles, guides, workflows, and scenarios.
  • Recreate real-world content workflows for AI evaluation.
  • Review AI outputs for quality, accuracy, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Provide feedback and annotations to support LLM improvement.
  • Collaborate with product and AI teams to align content with operational needs.


Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience as a Content Writer, Copywriter, or Technical Writer.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify content gaps or inconsistencies.
  • Familiarity with documentation or workflow tools (e.g., Confluence, Notion, Zendesk, Jira).
  • Excellent written communication skills.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 1 month


Evaluation Process :

  • Shortlisted candidates will be reviewed by our team internally and shortlisted candidates will be reached out for onboarding.

title: UI Designer
description:
A STEP é uma empresa de engenharia especializada no setor automotivo, reconhecida por sua excelência técnica e compromisso com a inovação. Fundada em 1992, a empresa estabeleceu sua sede em Turim, cidade considerada o centro do desenvolvimento automotivo na Itália.

Com o objetivo de expandir sua atuação e atender melhor às demandas regionais, a STEP inaugurou em 2004 a unidade Step do Sul , localizada em Pomigliano, na província de Nápoles.

Em 2009, dando continuidade ao seu plano de internacionalização, a empresa investiu na América Latina, o que resultou na abertura de uma Sede também em Contagem (Minas Gerais, Brasil) , ampliando sua presença no mercado global.



UI Design


Deliverables


Creation of innovative UI Design solutions to satisfy customer requests.

Creation of emotional presentation in order to explain the conceptual ideations and development of the project.


Management of the research phase:

  • Analysis and constant updating of technologies and design trends in present and future use;
  • Analysis of the current market in the context of the current project;
  • Mood board creations;
  • Management of the research phase and evaluation of customer requests and user requirements;
  • Participation in brainstorming sessions and workshops with the team;
  • Definition of the graphic concept.


Management of the design phase:

  • Create innovative graphic interfaces to satisfy customer requests; Development of a style guide and documentation to support the technical team;
  • Create 2D/3D assets, icons, color definitions and other graphic elements for prototyping and final production of the project.


Management of the development phase:

  • Presentation of proposals to customers;
  • Perfecting of the proposal chosen by the customer to meet their needs and suggest any improvements;
  • Collaboration with other Departments to integrate interdisciplinary technical aspects (CAS Department, Feasibility, Electric/Electronics).



General requirements

Following competence with high level of experience in the team are required:


  • Fluent English is MANDATORY because it is the official language of the project.
  • NICE TO HAVE Italian language.
  • Experience in Automotive Fields.
  • Knowledge of the needs of different types of users and ability to intercept those needs.
  • Analysis and benchmarking skills.
  • Identification of the technology that can at best intercept and satisfy customer requests with those offered by the reference market.
  • Ability to create emotional, engaging and convincing presentations towards customers (eg. mood board creation).
  • Ability to intercept the best solution in order to satisfy customer requests.
  • Deepened knowledge of Software in particular Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, After Effects, Blender as well as Microsoft Office package (PPT, Word, Excel, Outlook).
  • Customer orientation and ability to speak in public and facing the client.
  • Team work ability and empathy



Work Model

The candidate can work remotely and must be available to be contacted via Microsoft Teams for any meetings during European business hours.

title: Data Research Analyst
description:
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 3-5 years of data analysis and reporting experience
  • Advanced experience writing and creating large-scale surveys (QuestionPro, Qualtrics), analyzing results/data, and developing actionable findings
  • Experience with Tableau for data visualization
  • Experience in writing detailed reports and presenting data findings/analysis.

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Passion for video games/gaming in order to assist in writing and interpreting survey questions
  • Experience with SQL writing data queries
  • Snowflake or Data Bricks experience


Insight Global is hiring a Data Research Analyst to support the User Experience Research team at a leading company in the Gaming industry. The main role of the Data Research Analyst will be to create, send, and analyze large-scale surveys intended to learn about the player base of the core gaming products.

Job Functions

-Create surveys and trackers to support all products and initiatives

  • Design questions that do not bias respondents
  • Use best practice methodologies to produce actionable, accurate, and representative data.

-Advanced, survey focused, data visualizations (Tableau, Excel, Sheets)

  • Creating clear reports and dashboards based on surveys sent to players and users of their products.

-Data queries (HIVE, Snowflake, Tableau)

  • Querying multiple types of databases and plugging data queries directly into tools like Tableau are essential for this role. These skills will be used to target audiences for survey sends, pull in additional analytics to identify respondents, and allow for advanced data visualizations.

-Report writing and presenting data

  • Writing detailed and understandable reports that will speak to a variety of audiences across the enterprise
  • Presenting data in meetings and providing additional relevant context where applicable.

-Act as backup for all functions of current data researchers

-Provide support to UX researchers on report creation that involves data visualization.

-Quickly pivot with new data to ensure a constant flow of player insights are output as updated player survey data is received to ensure we are always reporting on timely and relevant findings.

-Contribute to overall needs of the UXR team e.g. peer review, supporting other teams with survey expertise, etc.

-Contribute survey expertise to assist others in the company with the creation of surveys.

title: Network Operations Center Technician
description:
Required Skills & Experience


  • 5 years experience troubleshooting DWDM Networks
  • 3 years experience with Ciena 6500 /Infinera/Alcatel PSS-32/16 required
  • 3 years experience in a network operations role required.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


  • Experience working in the field as a Fiber Technician


Job Description


A large telecommunications company is looking for a candidate that will be responsible for maintaining the stability and reliability of network services through advanced technical expertise and proactive coordination. The role includes performing complex troubleshooting and diagnostics, creating and deploying maintenance requests for after-hours network augments, and collaborating with the Network Control Center, Technical Assistance Center, and external vendors to ensure the health of priority circuits. Key duties involve monitoring network operations, conducting remote and off-net testing, managing escalations, and coordinating repair activities by dispatching field technicians and providing timely updates to customers. The position also requires gathering and analyzing network data, creating and executing scripts for repetitive tasks, and identifying automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency.

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer (Webflow + WordPress)
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.



What You’ll Do


  • Design and develop responsive, visually engaging websites in Webflow and WordPress .
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Translate approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow or WordPress.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Ensure all designs follow UX/UI best practices , accessibility standards, and performance guidelines.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Webflow/WordPress capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.


What You Bring


  • 3+ years of professional experience designing AND developing websites using Webflow and WordPress .
  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds .
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS , and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.



Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.



Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST , Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Senior Java Technical Lead (AI-Augmented Development)
description:
QAT Global , a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is seeking a highly skilled Senior Java Technical Lead to join our global engineering team. We deliver world-class technology solutions to clients across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, with a strong culture of engineering excellence and innovation.


This is a full-time, 100% remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to work directly with our US-based customer while collaborating with cross-functional, distributed teams.


About the Role

As a Senior Java Technical Lead , you will be responsible for leading all technical decision-making across backend and frontend development, ensuring architectural consistency, engineering best practices, and high-quality code delivery.

This role requires an expert-level Java professional who has begun integrating AI-assisted development workflows , including LLMs such as GPT and Claude, into their software engineering practices.


You will lead full-stack developers, collaborate closely with Solution Architects, BAs, DevOps, and AI Engineers, and oversee complex business domains such as Billing, Ledger, Invoice, and Remittance .

If you are a seasoned Java engineer who is also evolving into the new era of AI-enhanced software development, this role is for you.


Responsibilities


  • Lead all technical decision-making across backend and frontend architecture.
  • Ensure code quality, engineering best practices, and architectural coherence.
  • Guide full-stack developers implementing backend services and UI components.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architect, BA, DevOps, and AI Engineer to translate requirements into scalable, secure solutions.
  • Oversee complex financial and operational domains (Billing, Ledger, Invoice, Remittance).
  • Design, supervise, and optimize workflows that leverage LLMs for code generation, review, and refactoring.
  • Provide technical leadership on when and how to use AI tools safely and effectively.


Required Qualifications


Core Engineering Skills:


  • Senior-level Java/Spring Boot experience (expert level required).
  • Strong experience with Node.js , React , and Postgres .
  • Experience with Security, DevOps, Cloud , and GitHub ecosystem.
  • GitHub Advanced Security, GitHub CI/CD pipelines, and versioning best practices.


Cloud & Infrastructure:

  • Strong experience with AWS Identity Management .
  • Hands-on expertise with AWS workloads: EC2, RDS, SQS .


AI & LLM Experience (Required):


  • Solid understanding of LLMs and its capabilities.
  • Experience with Claude Sonnet 4.5 or similar models for:
  • Code generation
  • Code review
  • Code refactoring
  • Proficiency in prompt engineering , including:
  • Structured prompting
  • Chain-of-thought patterns
  • Constraints-driven prompting
  • Code-oriented prompting
  • Ability to guide developers on the safe, effective use of AI tools in daily engineering work.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)


  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical fields.
  • Experience leading distributed development teams.
  • Familiarity with modern architectural patterns and enterprise-level systems.

  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Anaplan Model Builder
description:
Job Title: Experienced Anaplan Model Builder (FP&A & Data Integration)

Nice to have skills: FP&A knowledge or certification, Anaplan Data Integration using Anaplan API or other tools.

Role Overview

We are seeking an Experienced Anaplan Model Builder with strong FP&A and data integration experience. The candidate will work closely with the Technical Manager, PDM (Product Development Manager), and directly with business stakeholders to deliver scalable Anaplan solutions and support ongoing operations.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure data accuracy, maintain documentation, and assist with troubleshooting.

  • 3+ years Anaplan model-building experience; Anaplan Model Builder certification required.
  • Strong FP&A knowledge (budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling).
  • Experience integrating Anaplan with ERP/CRM/data systems.
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills for direct business interaction.
  • Nice to have: Java or Python for API integrations with Anaplan; experience with SAP/Oracle/NetSuite/Workday, SQL, or ETL tools.

title: Profissional  FullStack NODEJS | .Net | Angular
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

  • O que você deve ter?
  • Experiência sólida com Node.js e desenvolvimento de APIs
  • Domínio de .NET (C#) e ASP.NET Core
  • Conhecimento avançado em Angular (preferencialmente versões 20+)
  • Experiência com PostgreSQL
  • Conhecimento em MongoDB e/ou DocumentDB
  • Versionamento com Git
  • Conhecimento em TypeScript
  • Inglês intermediário

⭐ Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com NestJS
  • Arquitetura de microserviços
  • Arquitetura de microfrontend
  • Familiaridade com Docker
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Ferramentas de CI/CD
  • RxJS e programação reativa
  • Testes unitários e de integração (Jest, xUnit)
  • Conhecimento em design patterns

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS )
  • Familiaridade com práticas DevOps


O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Senior Full-Stack Web Application Developer with 7+ years of experience producing commercial-grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities, an aptitude for learning new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The company's solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit from the automation of the most complex business processes, reducing operating costs, saving time, and increasing profitability through reporting, analytics, and decision-support systems once exclusive to major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance legacy application - JavaScript frontend and PHP backend running on Linux, nginx (engine x), fpm, and mostly MySQL
  • Modernize software solution using React.js and/or Vue.js design, architect, develop, deliver, and sustain
  • Take technical ownership of features and their impact on the business - assist with refining functional and technical specifications
  • Deliver product features and updates with minimal direction, yet know when to seek help to remain efficient
  • Review and approve pull requests from less senior developers and assure alignment with established best practices
  • Build and execute unit tests
  • Interact with end-users/customers to ensure smooth deployments and to understand needs/issues
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Display comprehensive understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), as applied to projects of increasing size and complexity, with emphasis on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • Analysis and design
  • Estimating
  • Planning



REQUIRED (Must Have):

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • 4+ years of experience using JavaScript, PHP, and Linux
  • Passion for whole product delivery and exceptional customer experiences, must have experience considering architectural side-effects, edge-cases, backward compatibility, integrations, and internal/external team/customer enablement
  • Experience building, delivering, and sustaining production, commercial-quality, n-tiered software architecture web-based applications
  • Prior success as a senior developer coaching less skilled/experienced developers, establishing coding guidelines/best practices, and reviewing pull requests
  • Familiarity with varied data capture, normalization/transformation, and storage/management that enable high-performance data querying for reporting
  • Experience working with Agile and other development methodologies
  • Ability to work independently yet know when to seek assistance to ensure deadlines are met with high quality
  • Team player with practical communication skills and collaborative approach
  • Strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly
  • Flexibility and openness to new ideas or change, with the passion and drive to excel in their career
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, creative, and accountable


PREFERRED (But NOT Required):

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Familiar with nginx web server (aka "Engine X")
  • Experience with React.js or Vue.js
  • Familiarity with the upstream and midstream oil/gas industry


What YOU Get!

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.



Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Attention to detail is key to this position.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Understand how to use a web browser console log in the debugging process
  • Understanding of Public/Priviate IP addresses and Domain names
  • Understanding what a Firewall does
  • What does a Proxy Server do
  • Understanding of the basics of SSO


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Representante de Vendas
description:
About Refer

Refer is an exclusive AI-powered career agent that connects top talent from Stanford, MIT, Harvard, and other top 20 US universities to leading tech companies like NVIDIA, Meta, Glean, DeepMind, Scale AI, and 1,000+ startups.


We are expanding rapidly and launching a Refer & Earn program so more people can help us grow this elite talent community — and get rewarded for it.


✨ About the Role

We’re looking for Sales Representatives who want a flexible, remote opportunity to help talented people find great jobs — and get paid extremely well for it.


This is not a typical “marketing” or “recruiting” job.


Your role is simple:

Share Refer with people who qualify

When they join and get accepted — you earn

If they get hired — you earn big

That's it.


Compensation (Commission Only)

You earn:

  • $50 for every qualified user you bring who signs up
  • $1,000 if they get hired or make a hire through Refer

There is no limit to how much you can earn.

Some ambassadors make a few hundred dollars per week.

Some make thousands.


Who Should Apply

This role is perfect for people who:

  • Are active on LinkedIn
  • Have friends from top universities
  • Know people in tech or startups
  • Are involved in online communities
  • Want a flexible side gig with high upside
  • Want to help people find jobs that match their potential

No experience required.

Just bring people to Refer — we do the rest.


Who Qualifies to Be Referred

You’ll have the most success referring people who are:

  • Job seekers with a degree from a top 20 US university , OR
  • Hiring managers / team leads at top tech companies or startups
  • US-based only

You’ll receive more details and tools after joining.


What You’ll Do

As a Sales Representative, you will:

  • Promote Refer
  • Post about Refer in relevant online communities
  • Invite top talent and hiring managers to join
  • Use your unique invitation link to track earnings
  • Help us grow the strongest talent network in the country

We’ll provide:

  • Messaging templates
  • Guidance on where to promote
  • Best practices to maximize your earnings

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (React.js / Python)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Developer with 4+ years of full-stack experience primarily focused on React.js front-end development. You will join our clients' innovative, growing team on a mission to unleash the power of culture for growing organizational brands at a time of global, seismic cultural transformation.

You will participate in the complete software development process from conception to deployment of our clients ' world-class data and insights platform. You will work closely with product and UX leads, providing a critical voice in solutioning complex workflows and user experiences.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, then you are the right person for the job. The ideal candidate must collaborate well within a team, leverage strong technological expertise, and adeptly analyze and prioritize features and requirements. You will build upon our clients' next-generation front-end user experience, connecting it to and enhancing the backend data pipeline.

Our client unleashes the power of culture to drive brand growth through consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 major U.S. brands. Its solutions are powered by its cultural intelligence platform, which enables its customers to understand, reach, and engage consumers more effectively and efficiently, activating them across race, ethnicity, generation, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • Work with development teams and product managers to ideate software solutions
  • Architect and build application front-ends with appealing visual design
  • Develop functional, scalable applications
  • Write effective APIs
  • Test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade software
  • Create security and data protection settings
  • Build features and applications with a mobile-responsive design
  • Write technical documentation
  • Work with data scientists and analysts to improve AI/ML-based software


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 4+ years of full-stack development experience primarily using React.js in the front-end
  • Knowledge of additional front-end languages and libraries (e.g., HTML / CSS, JavaScript, XML, and jQuery)
  • 2+ years working in AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud platform
  • 1+ years of Python experience
  • Familiarity with databases (e.g., MySQL and MongoDB), web servers (e.g., Apache), and UI/UX design
  • Great attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and an analytical mind
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer science, statistics, or a relevant field
  • Experience with DataViz
  • Experience with Snowflake, Flask, Django, or FastAPI


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.


What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications in relevant conferences/journals


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Full-Stack Developer (React Native + Python / FastAPI / AWS)
description:
About PhilSocial:


PhilSocial is a blockchain-powered Give-to-Earn platform transforming how social media influences the world. Valued at $1.2 B (2024) and empowering over 250,000 users worldwide , PhilSocial merges the best of social media with the best of humanity — creating the world’s first peer-to-peer social movement . We empower people to give, connect, and earn — bringing impact and generosity to the center of digital life.


About Position:

Position: Full-Stack Developer (React Native + Python / FastAPI / AWS)


Role Overview:


We’re looking for a mid- to senior-level Full-Stack Developer with strong experience in React Native and Python (FastAPI) , familiar with AWS cloud architectures , and passionate about writing elegant, clean, and scalable code.

You’ll join a cross-functional global team (Brazil, USA, Dubai, Spain, Ukraine, Colombia, and more) responsible for building new, complex features for the next phase of PhilSocial — while maintaining and improving current modules of our social media platform.

You’ll work remotely and collaborate daily with our Tech Lead in Brazil and Corporate Teams in the US and Dubai .


Responsibilities:


  • Develop new features and modules for the PhilSocial mobile app (React Native + Expo / CLI).
  • Maintain and refactor existing code with a focus on scalability, performance, and security.
  • Implement RESTful and asynchronous APIs using FastAPI , aligned with DDD and Hexagonal Architecture principles.
  • Collaborate with designers, blockchain engineers, and backend specialists to build seamless user experiences.
  • Contribute to system architecture discussions and participate in technical design reviews.
  • Write well-tested, documented, and maintainable code following Clean Code / SOLID practices.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and optimize API performance on AWS (Fargate, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFront, etc.).
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and code reviews across time zones.


Requirements:


Frontend / Mobile (React Native):

  • React Native (Expo & CLI)
  • Zustand (state management)
  • MMKV (persistent storage)
  • React Query (data fetching & caching)
  • TypeScript


Backend (Python / FastAPI):

  • FastAPI, Pydantic, Async I/O
  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
  • SOLID principles
  • Hexagonal architecture
  • REST / GraphQL API design
  • AWS (Lambda, Fargate, EKS, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFront)


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Web3 / Blockchain integrations
  • Familiarity with smart contracts or Solid protocol


Leadership Skills:

  • Ability to design scalable systems and make key technical decisions.
  • Experience leading 2–8 developers with accountability for delivery.
  • Clear communication, mentoring, and Agile mindset.


You’ll Succeed in This Role If You:

  • Are a go-to problem solver — you diagnose and fix complex issues independently.
  • Deliver high-quality, efficient, and clean code with excellent attention to detail.
  • Demonstrate technical leadership — mentoring others and influencing best practices.
  • Have strong time management — you’re reliable and proactive across global teams.
  • Communicate clearly in English (written & spoken intermediate+) ;
  • Thrive in a remote, multicultural environment , collaborating asynchronously when needed.


We offer:

  • Meaningful projects in social digital finance that impact real users.
  • Modern React stack, flexibility, and product ownership culture.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Full-time role in an international environment.


Compensation & Engagement:

  • Contract Type: Full-time Contractor (Remote)
  • Monthly Rate: based on experience and region
  • Work Schedule: Flexible / Global Team Coordination
  • Location: Anywhere (PhilSocial operates globally)


How to Apply:

Send your CV / Portfolio / GitHub to with the subject line:

“Full-Stack Developer – PhilSocial”

  • Include links to any relevant repositories or apps you’ve built.

description:

description:
Position Summary

We are looking for a Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist to join a fast-growing real estate startup in the U.S. This is a hybrid role that combines helpdesk support, HubSpot operations, outbound sales assistance, and light marketing support.

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing support tickets, excellent communication skills, deep familiarity with HubSpot, and the ability to multitask across customer support, RevOps, and sales processes in a fast-paced startup environment.


Key Responsibilities

Customer Support & Helpdesk (40–50%)

  • Serve as the primary responder for inbound support tickets from users.
  • Monitor, triage, and resolve issues through HubSpot Service Hub.
  • Maintain strong response/resolution times with empathetic, professional communication.
  • Document common issues and build internal resources or playbooks.


HubSpot Operations & Administration (20–25%)

  • Manage and optimize workflows, pipelines, automations, and ticket management across HubSpot.
  • Maintain data accuracy for contacts, deals, and support tickets.
  • Support setup and QA of new sequences, processes, and automation in HubSpot.
  • Pull basic reports on sales activity, ticket volume, and marketing performance.


Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting (20–25%)

  • Execute outbound email campaigns and sequences targeting prospects such as real estate agents or brokers.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads following defined playbooks.
  • Set calls and demos for the sales team.
  • Track all activities and updates inside HubSpot.


Marketing Support (5–10%)

  • Assist with email marketing campaigns, list building, and segmentation.
  • Support basic digital marketing tasks as needed.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of customer support or helpdesk experience (B2B SaaS experience preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including:
  • Service/Operations Hub (tickets, workflows, automation)
  • Sales Hub (pipelines, deals, sequences, tasks)
  • Proven success managing support tickets as a core responsibility.
  • Experience supporting outbound sales workflows, sequences, and appointment setting.
  • Familiarity with email marketing or digital campaign support.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with shifting demands.
  • Availability to work 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM MST .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in real estate or PropTech industries.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, ClickUp, and Canva.
  • Experience building support documentation, macros, or knowledge base articles.
  • Track record of improving support metrics or boosting outbound meeting conversions.


What We Offer

  • Fully Remote Position! Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and skill development.

title: Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
Position Summary

We are looking for a Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist to join a fast-growing real estate startup in the U.S. This is a hybrid role that combines helpdesk support, HubSpot operations, outbound sales assistance, and light marketing support.

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing support tickets, excellent communication skills, deep familiarity with HubSpot, and the ability to multitask across customer support, RevOps, and sales processes in a fast-paced startup environment.


Key Responsibilities

Customer Support & Helpdesk (40–50%)

  • Serve as the primary responder for inbound support tickets from users.
  • Monitor, triage, and resolve issues through HubSpot Service Hub.
  • Maintain strong response/resolution times with empathetic, professional communication.
  • Document common issues and build internal resources or playbooks.


HubSpot Operations & Administration (20–25%)

  • Manage and optimize workflows, pipelines, automations, and ticket management across HubSpot.
  • Maintain data accuracy for contacts, deals, and support tickets.
  • Support setup and QA of new sequences, processes, and automation in HubSpot.
  • Pull basic reports on sales activity, ticket volume, and marketing performance.


Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting (20–25%)

  • Execute outbound email campaigns and sequences targeting prospects such as real estate agents or brokers.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads following defined playbooks.
  • Set calls and demos for the sales team.
  • Track all activities and updates inside HubSpot.


Marketing Support (5–10%)

  • Assist with email marketing campaigns, list building, and segmentation.
  • Support basic digital marketing tasks as needed.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of customer support or helpdesk experience (B2B SaaS experience preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including:
  • Service/Operations Hub (tickets, workflows, automation)
  • Sales Hub (pipelines, deals, sequences, tasks)
  • Proven success managing support tickets as a core responsibility.
  • Experience supporting outbound sales workflows, sequences, and appointment setting.
  • Familiarity with email marketing or digital campaign support.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with shifting demands.

Preferred Qualifications
