Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer to join one of our USA Clients' engineering teams which is building solutions to dramatically change the way people purchase their daily goods, providing the modern-day solution to meet customer’s immediate everyday needs with products ranging from snacks and ice cream to household goods and beer, at the click of a button.   • Generate time estimates with reasonable accuracy to help determine project timelines.
  • Support standard development practices across your team, including idiomatic syntax, design patterns, and Testing/Quality Practice.
  • Provide primary operational support and engineering for multiple large distributed software applications.

Our offer – professional development, personal growth

  • Educational resources
  • Flexible schedule and work from anywhere

title: Customer Service Representative - Relocation Required
description:
Vantage is a global, multi-regulated, multi-asset broker based in Sydney, offering clients access to trading CFDs on Forex, Commodities, Indices, Shares, and Cryptocurrencies. With over 10 years of market experience, Vantage has a strong presence with more than 1,000 employees across 30 global offices. Vantage provides a trusted trading ecosystem and a user-friendly platform for clients to capitalize on trading opportunities.


OPEN ONLY to individuals willing to relocate.


This is a unique opportunity for Customer Service Rockstars interested in living and developing a career in Southeast Asia: Malaysia or Thailand . The company will provide all necessary visa assistance and relocation support. During the visa processing, work remotely from your base country.


Responsibilities:

  • Provide frontline support to our customers via live chat, phone, and email.
  • Answering queries and resolving client issues regarding our products, platforms, and promotions.
  • Address customer feedback and complaints professionally.
  • Record and update customer data and other relevant information when necessary.
  • Supporting documentation/administrative needs within the department and supporting translation for customer announcement notices.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree, fresh graduates welcome to apply.
  • Over 2 years of experience in Customer Service, highly preferred in crypto or fintech, but any industry is welcome.
  • Mandatory rotation shift schedule with night shifts once relocated.
  • Experience in international settings and teams.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese is MANDATORY
  • Exceptional communication skills with a superb client focus.
  • Logical and analytical approach to problem-solving.
  • Knowledge or interest in trading is highly desirable, but not essential.


We offer :

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Remote work while relocation is processed
  • Local benefits according to the chosen relocation country
  • Relocation support, including visa sponsorship and additional expenses
  • Career development in a fast-paced industry

description:

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineers


Breakthrough Talent is currently supporting a leading data business build a brand new data platform to support a modern data mesh organisation. They work with national and global clients across data, software and digital consulting, and they are now looking for a Data Infrastructure Engineer to help build and scale their next generation platform.


This role suits someone who enjoys owning infrastructure, building reusable solutions, and supporting data teams with analytics and AI ready environments.


The Role


As a Data Engineer you will design, build and maintain the core infrastructure that enables data processing, analytics, data science and data management across the business.


You will work in a multi account and multi region AWS environment that follows zero trust and least privilege principles. Infrastructure as Code and CI CD will be central to how you operate, alongside continuous improvement and strong governance.


What You Will Do


  • Build and maintain cloud based infrastructure using Cloud Formation and SAM
  • Design and implement data processing environments using AWS services such as Glue, EMR, Sagemaker, Redshift, Aurora and Snowflake
  • Build data processing pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, Spark, Lambda, Step Functions and Apache Airflow
  • Monitor performance, cost and security of the data platform
  • Apply strong data governance and access control for sensitive data
  • Collaborate with multiple teams to support the wider data platform strategy


What You Need


  • Six years or more experience in a Data Engineering or Data Infrastructure role
  • Strong experience building data architectures in AWS
  • Solid coding skills in Python and SQL, Golang
  • Strong Cloud Formation knowledge
  • Experience working with relational databases such as Postgres or Redshift
  • Good coding discipline including documentation, unit testing and version control
  • Experience with Git and CI CD tools such as GitLab
  • Worked in Agile teams and ceremonies
  • Strong problem solving skills and excellent communication


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Jira or similar project management tools
  • Experience with Snowflake
  • Spatial data processing experience


If you would like to learn more about the role, please reach out to Jake Denman at Breakthrough Talent.

title: DevOps Pleno - GCP
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS , com vivência prática em serviços como EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer to join one of our USA Clients' engineering teams which is building solutions to dramatically change the way people purchase their daily goods, providing the modern-day solution to meet customer’s immediate everyday needs with products ranging from snacks and ice cream to household goods and beer, at the click of a button. Sobre a vaga

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

description:

description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS , com vivência prática em serviços como EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior "#983964"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento da área de Tecnologia.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados usando Spark, PySpark ou Scala no Databricks, garantindo automação e performance em processos ETL de grande volume;
  • Modelar, integrar e transformar dados complexos utilizando SQL avançado, assegurando qualidade e disponibilidade para áreas de negócio e analytics;
  • Criar e otimizar jobs em Spark para ingestão, limpeza, padronização e enriquecimento de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes;
  • Monitorar, documentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de dados, garantindo governança, escalabilidade, segurança e alto desempenho em ambientes de nuvem e plataformas como Databricks.

O que você precisa ter

  • Conhecimento de SQL e experiência com Databricks;
  • Familiaridade com Power BI e Tableau;
  • Proficiência em SQL e experiência prática com Databricks, Spark e Scala;
  • Experiência na criação de dashboards com Power BI;
  • Familiaridade com integração de jobs Spark para processos ETL;
  • Habilidades avançadas em SQL para manipulação e integração complexa de dados;
  • Expertise em Databricks, Spark, Scala e PySpark para engenharia de dados em larga escala;
  • Experiência em Azure;
  • Experiência em mensageria (Kafka, Service Bus).


Qualificações

  • Bacharelado em Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência em engenharia de dados ou funções relacionadas;
  • Experiência no setor financeiro/adquirência.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Regime de Contratação

CLT.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Control M;
  • Experiência prévia em Desenvolvimento Java;
  • Espanhol e Inglês.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Hey, Dev, check the opportunity we have here at Brick Abode!


About Brick Abode


We are a software development company that serves clients from multiple countries around the world, with differing technological needs. Therefore, we value a good computer science base.


Contractors with a solid understanding of the basic building blocks of today’s technology are really welcome and thrive at Brick Abode.


People here are given autonomy, not put into a box to work only on one thing. They are in touch with the business needs of our clients, sometimes communicating with them directly.


We challenge ourselves to learn new things and go outside our comfort zone. Candidates who are up to the challenge will have an amazing career with us.


If you feel that your values fit with Brick Abode culture, check below for further details about this Position.


What kind of professional are we looking for?


We’re looking for a responsible and proactive professional who can navigate between technology and business contexts with ease, feel comfortable in fast-paced environments, and have great communication skills.

Our team is Brazil and USA-based, and communication is in English. The position is fully remote.



What do I need to have to apply for this position?


  • Python (with strong data handling experience): ETL pipelines, familiarity with DataFrames (Pandas or similar)
  • PostgreSQL (loading, validation, filtering)
  • Familiarity with the AWS Cloud ecosystem
  • CI/CD and code hygiene for data pipelines
  • Machine Learning
  • Fluent English
  • An academic background (MSc or PhD) will also be a plus



As Contractor (PJ), you will have:


  • Competitive compensation (in Reais - R$)
  • Work with international clients with international standards
  • Opportunity to grow as a leader
  • Possibility to move between teams
  • Speak in English with your coworkers
  • 2 weeks of paid leave per year
  • National holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid marriage leave
  • Working with a company that cares about our people and their personal growth
  • All expenses paid for training, conferences, and online courses
  • Remote work
  • Health Care Plan - Online


If you are passionate about technology and have a strong desire to work on cutting-edge projects, we encourage you to apply for this position!


Submit your CV to make sure it contains your LinkedIn and GitHub accounts.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

title: Software Engineer (Murex)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Murex Developer to join our team, supporting strategic initiatives within the financial sector. The role begins as fully remote , with the expectation of relocation to Portugal after an agreed transition period. You will work closely with multicultural teams, contributing to the enhancement and stability of the Murex MX.3 platform.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, customize, and maintain components and configurations within Murex MX.3 , across modules such as Trading, Risk, Collateral, and Back Office.
  • Build and enhance workflows, simulation views, formulas, and MxML Exchange interfaces.
  • Design and maintain integrations with internal and external systems (REST, SOAP, MQ, APIs, ETL, etc.).
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents, ensuring system stability and performance.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, QA, and project teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Support release cycles, functional testing, regression testing, and UAT phases.
  • Maintain compliance with technical standards, documentation, and governance processes.


Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Murex MX.3 (configuration, development, or integration).
  • Solid knowledge of Datamart, MxML Exchange, Workflows, Simulation Views , and other core Murex components.
  • Strong programming skills: Java, SQL, Shell Script , and ideally Python.
  • Experience with system integrations, middleware, or messaging platforms.
  • Good understanding of financial instruments, especially derivatives (FX, IRD, Fixed Income, Equities, Commodities).
  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Willingness and eligibility to relocate to Portugal after the initial remote period.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience working with major banks or large international financial institutions.
  • Knowledge of DevOps methodologies and tools (CI/CD, Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum .
  • Murex certifications or experience with MX.2 → MX.3 migrations.

Desired Profile

  • Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving ability.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in remote and multicultural environments.
  • Proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and capable of working under pressure.
  • Motivated to engage in a long-term role involving relocation.

What We Offer

  • Remote work during the initial phase.
  • Support and guidance for future relocation to Portugal .
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Opportunity to work on complex, high-impact financial systems.
  • Multicultural work environment and professional growth opportunities.

title: Multidisciplinary Designer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa talentosa, experiente e comprometida para integrar nosso time.


Somos a commcepta, um estúdio de Design Management sediado em Curitiba com atuação global. Um time de talentos multidisciplinares com o propósito de superar a si mesmo a cada novo desafio. Somos membros, parte do Advisory Council e premiados pelo Design Management Institute (DMI), além de outras alianças estratégicas que somam conhecimento e reconhecem nossa atuação ao longo dos nossos mais de 25 anos. Mergulhamos fundo em pesquisa, conceituamos a solução para o problema e aplicamos Design em busca de um desenvolvimento sustentável, colaborativo e orgânico.


✏️ Sua função

Seu papel como Multidisciplinary Designer será somar na tradução daquilo que encontramos e validamos em pesquisa, conectados ao conceito central do projeto e integrados à estratégia do nosso cliente. Tudo isso alinhado ao nosso propósito de superar a nós mesmos em tudo o que fazemos.

A profundidade do nosso pensamento e a imersão no cliente são premissas do nosso trabalho. Primeiro, questionamos o problema, para depois buscar as possíveis soluções. Por isso, as possibilidades são múltiplas e permeiam todos os pontos de contato do público com a marca. A versatilidade do seu trabalho para elaborar diferentes materiais e sua habilidade em lidar com diversos segmentos contam muitos pontos para este papel.


✨ Nossas expectativas


Esperamos que todo(a) commcepter:

  • Traga novas ideias, some e vá além do “briefing”
  • Seja caprichoso, organizado e tenha atenção aos detalhes
  • Saiba ouvir e trabalhar colaborativamente
  • Concorde que design é mais do que layout e conceito não é “blá blá”
  • Goste de trabalhar com diferentes projetos, dos simples aos mais complexos
  • Busque aprender e se desenvolver com novas experiências e situações desafiadoras
  • Tenha uma visão ampla sem perder o foco nas operações do dia a dia
  • Seja comprometido e tenha vontade de crescer


Como Multidisciplinary Designer, esperamos que você:

  • Desenhe peças incríveis que deixem todo mundo orgulhoso
  • Seja hábil na criação de composições visualmente atraentes e cheias de significado
  • Seja inovador na criação de campanhas e comunicação de marca
  • Saiba conduzir uma boa pesquisa, conectando referências e autoridades do tema
  • Tenha um bom conhecimento do pacote Adobe (InDesign, Illustrator e Photoshop)
  • Tenha um nível de inglês intermediário para lidar com projetos globais


Especialidades desejadas:

  • Ter uma boa redação para a criação de chamadas e conteúdos
  • Ter habilidades de composição de storyboards e de animações / motion graphics
  • E/ou se interessar por UX-UI Design, saber criar e prototipar interfaces


Key Words: Multidisciplinary Design / Graphic Design / Brand Design / Visual Design / Brand Communication / Digital Design / Content Design / Design Research / Motion Design


Híbrido - Curitiba (Remote First)


É importante você saber que nossa forma de trabalho principal é remota, por isso contamos que você esteja disposto a trabalhar em casa. Buscamos pessoas que moram em Curitiba e região para encontros presenciais em nossa sede, quando necessário.

title: Human Resources Assistant
description:
Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions (Effective 8/01/25)


  • Do you live in Brazil and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing?
  • Do you love to read, write, and analyze things?
  • Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker?
  • Can you type both fast and accurately?
  • Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge and your income?
  • Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a stable, long-term career related to HR?
  • Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail?
  • Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting?
  • Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations?
  • Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities?


If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team! Please review the minimum education/experience requirements below to see if you qualify for the position.


About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies.


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.


Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:


Compensation:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $4,200 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. Work as a CLS HR & Investigation Assistant for a minimum of 1 year with competent performance and become eligible for promotion to the Specialist position.


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting total monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $9,000 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. 


Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:


·      High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.


Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office

Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.


Minimum/Required and Preferred Qualifications


Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT:

·      Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

·      A minimum of 1 year of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 1-year requirement).

·      A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

·      A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.

·      Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.

·      3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred. 

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred.


Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST:

·      Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

·      At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English is required . Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English.

·      A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is required.

·      Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.

·      A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required. A Master's Degree is preferred.

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred .


GROW at CLS! PROMOTIONAL POSITIONS ONLY for CURRENT CLS TEAM MEMBERS:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SUPERVISOR (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $9,800 BRL to $16,800 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6-months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION MANAGER (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $16,800 BRL to $27,000 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6 months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.


How to Apply? 2 Steps for a Complete Application


Please read the entire job description carefully and apply if you meet all the minimum requirements.


STEP #1: Send an email with the following to :

·      Your current/updated resume in English.

·      A written statement about how you satisfy each of the required and preferred qualifications for the position.

·      Your job salary history for all jobs listed on your resume (including starting and ending salary for each job stated in COP) and any bonus opportunities that you had in each job.


STEP #2:

We would like to evaluate your English verbal skills. Please send a video message via WhatsApp at and introduce yourself. (Please do not read. Speak naturally.)


You must provide all the requested information and complete all the steps listed above for your application to be complete.


Please send your complete application as soon as possible. We are coordinating interviews now!

For more information about the company, please visit:

title: Manager Operations BPS Brazil
description:
Role Purpose

Drive continuous improvement initiatives across BPS operations to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve service quality. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify process gaps and implement best practices.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide timely and meaningful reporting to senior management.
  • Plan and implement strategies to ensure account profitability.
  • Handle client interactions and manage escalations (calls or in-person).
  • Conduct regular reviews with Account Managers and other departments to ensure SLA adherence.

title: Human Resources Assistant
description:
Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions (Effective 8/01/25)


  • Do you live in Brazil and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing?
  • Do you love to read, write, and analyze things?
  • Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker?
  • Can you type both fast and accurately?
  • Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge and your income?
  • Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a stable, long-term career related to HR?
  • Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail?
  • Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting?
  • Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations?
  • Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities?


If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team! Please review the minimum education/experience requirements below to see if you qualify for the position.


About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies.


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.


Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:


Compensation:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $4,200 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. Work as a CLS HR & Investigation Assistant for a minimum of 1 year with competent performance and become eligible for promotion to the Specialist position.


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting total monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $9,000 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. 


Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:


·      High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.


Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office

Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.


Minimum/Required and Preferred Qualifications


Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT:

·      Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

·      A minimum of 1 year of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 1-year requirement).

·      A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

·      A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.

·      Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.

·      3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred. 

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred.


Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST:

·      Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

·      At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English is required . Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English.

·      A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is required.

·      Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.

·      A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required. A Master's Degree is preferred.

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred .


GROW at CLS! PROMOTIONAL POSITIONS ONLY for CURRENT CLS TEAM MEMBERS:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SUPERVISOR (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $9,800 BRL to $16,800 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6-months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION MANAGER (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $16,800 BRL to $27,000 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6 months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.


How to Apply? 2 Steps for a Complete Application


Please read the entire job description carefully and apply if you meet all the minimum requirements.


STEP #1: Send an email with the following to :

·      Your current/updated resume in English.

·      A written statement about how you satisfy each of the required and preferred qualifications for the position.

·      Your job salary history for all jobs listed on your resume (including starting and ending salary for each job stated in COP) and any bonus opportunities that you had in each job.


STEP #2:

We would like to evaluate your English verbal skills. Please send a video message via WhatsApp at and introduce yourself. (Please do not read. Speak naturally.)


You must provide all the requested information and complete all the steps listed above for your application to be complete.


Please send your complete application as soon as possible. We are coordinating interviews now!

title: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 56240


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional Engenheiro de Dados, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

• Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform .

• Domínio em: o BigQuery o Cloud Storage (GCS) o Cloud Run o Vertex AI o Airflow/Cloud Composer

• Vivência prática na criação, versionamento e monitoramento de DAGs.

• Proficiência em Python e conhecimento intermediário/avançado em SQL .

• Conhecimento de arquiteturas Lakehouse.

• Experiência com CI/CD (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions) .

• Experiência com Git e boas práticas de engenharia de dados.


Responsabilidades

• Desenvolver, evoluir e manter DAGs no Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer.

• Construir pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) escaláveis e de alta performance.

• Criar modelos, tabelas e rotinas de dados no BigQuery.

• Implementar integrações e serviços utilizando Cloud Run ou Cloud Functions.

• Estruturar e gerenciar camadas de dados no Google Cloud Storage.

• Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e analytics na definição de soluções de dados.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

description:
Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions (Effective 8/01/25)


  • Do you live in Brazil and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing?
  • Do you love to read, write, and analyze things?
  • Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker?
  • Can you type both fast and accurately?
  • Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge and your income?
  • Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a stable, long-term career related to HR?
  • Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail?
  • Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting?
  • Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations?
  • Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities?


If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team! Please review the minimum education/experience requirements below to see if you qualify for the position.


About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies.


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.


Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:


Compensation:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $4,200 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. Work as a CLS HR & Investigation Assistant for a minimum of 1 year with competent performance and become eligible for promotion to the Specialist position.


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting total monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $9,000 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. 


Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:


·      High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.


Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office

Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.


Minimum/Required and Preferred Qualifications


Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT:

·      Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

·      A minimum of 1 year of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 1-year requirement).

·      A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

·      A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.

·      Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.

·      3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred. 

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred.


Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST:

·      Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

·      At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English is required . Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English.

·      A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is required.

·      Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.

·      A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required. A Master's Degree is preferred.

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred .


GROW at CLS! PROMOTIONAL POSITIONS ONLY for CURRENT CLS TEAM MEMBERS:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SUPERVISOR (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $9,800 BRL to $16,800 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6-months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION MANAGER (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $16,800 BRL to $27,000 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6 months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.


How to Apply? 2 Steps for a Complete Application


Please read the entire job description carefully and apply if you meet all the minimum requirements.


STEP #1: Send an email with the following to :

·      Your current/updated resume in English.

·      A written statement about how you satisfy each of the required and preferred qualifications for the position.

·      Your job salary history for all jobs listed on your resume (including starting and ending salary for each job stated in COP) and any bonus opportunities that you had in each job.


STEP #2:

We would like to evaluate your English verbal skills. Please send a video message via WhatsApp at and introduce yourself. (Please do not read. Speak naturally.)

title: Desenvolvedor de Dynamics
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior Dynamics 365 – Backend | Remoto | Mouts TI


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior Dynamics 365 (Backend) para atuar em um projeto estratégico de transformação digital, com foco na evolução de produtos internos e em integrações complexas entre plataformas corporativas. • Vivência com Power Platform

• Experiência com Azure Services (Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management)

• Habilidade com SQL Server, modelagem de dados e integrações

• Conhecimento em padrões arquiteturais e APIs REST/SOAP

• Uso de Git e pipelines de CI/CD

• Vivência com metodologias ágeis


Diferenciais:

• Certificações Microsoft

• Experiência em ambientes corporativos e projetos de transformação digital

title: Video Editor
description:
28th&Park is a creative studio built for the modern content era — where ideas move fast, visuals captivate instantly, and culture drives connection. We collaborate with brands and founders who want to make noise in the right way — through bold storytelling and visually charged campaigns that actually hit.


We’re looking for a Video Editor who lives and breathes short-form and long-form content — someone who can turn raw footage into high-energy, perfectly-paced edits that grab attention in the first second. You’ll be cutting dynamic reels, shorts, founder clips, and launch moments across platforms like LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.


What You’ll Do

  • Edit short-form, social-native videos that bring energy, emotion, and precision.
  • Adapt storytelling for platforms — quick hooks, rhythm, movement, and retention.
  • Collaborate with creative producers and brand leads to craft visual storylines.
  • Add motion graphics, captions, and subtle effects that enhance engagement.
  • Maintain speed and consistency, delivering edits that feel alive and on-brand.
  • Create and polish long form video that might include interviews, events, and documentaries.


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience editing high-impact videos (show us your reels or portfolio).
  • Expert in tools like Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve.
  • Strong sense of pacing, trend awareness, and tone-matching.
  • Ability to find the narrative beating heart in any clip, even a casual founder video.
  • Comfort iterating quickly — you move fast and deliver faster.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with branded content, creator storytelling, or startup media.
  • Knowledge of sound design and dynamic transitions for modern social style.


Send your portfolio or 2–3 sample clips that show your editing range to with the subject line: Video Editor – 28th&Park.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Hiring: Cloud Engineer (GCP / AWS / Python / AVID MAM)

Location: Remote / Hybrid (based on region)

Experience Level: Mid–Senior


About the Role


We are looking for a skilled Cloud Engineer with strong experience across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, Python development, and workflow migration. The ideal candidate will also have hands-on expertise with AVID Media Asset Management (MAM) systems and the ability to support modern CI/CD deployment practices.


This role involves cloud-based workflow modernization, application and media workflow migration, automation scripting, and integration across cloud environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Design, implement, and support solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and AWS.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and integrations using Python.
  • Lead or support workflow migration initiatives from legacy systems to cloud-native architectures.
  • Work with AVID MAM systems for media workflow integration, configuration, and automation support.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support continuous deployment and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, media operations, DevOps) to design efficient and scalable solutions.
  • Troubleshoot cloud-based applications, media workflows, and infrastructure issues.


Required Skills & Experience


  • Strong hands-on expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with AWS services, cloud deployment models, and cross-cloud integration.
  • Proficiency in Python for automation, scripting, data processing, or workflow integration.
  • Proven experience in workflow migration (media workflows preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • AVID MAM (Avid Media Asset Management) experience is mandatory.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, optimize, and document cloud and media workflows.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team.


Nice to Have


  • Experience with media workflows, broadcast systems, or video delivery platforms.
  • Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with storage, CDN, streaming, or metadata management in cloud environments.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno (IA - BI)
description:
Conheça abaixo as oportunidades que estão disponíveis no momento:


  • Engenheiro de Dados Pleno (IA)
  • Engenheiro de Dados Pleno (BI)


Qual será sua ocupação?


Engenheiro de Dados Pleno


O que esperamos de você?


Engenheiro de Dados Pleno (IA):

  • Experiência em modelagem, arquitetura e integração de dados (DW, Data Lake, Lakehouse).
  • Domínio de Python e SQL, além de trabalhar bem com frameworks de processamento como Spark, Databricks, Airflow ou equivalentes.
  • Vivência na construção de pipelines escaláveis e de alto desempenho, com práticas modernas de versionamento, testes e CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento aplicado em soluções de Machine Learning/IA, incluindo preparação de dados para modelos, feature store, monitoramento e integração com modelos em produção.
  • Experiência com serviços em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência em SQL Server, incluindo consultas, modelagem de dados e otimização de desempenho.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação de processos, como UiPath, Open RPA, N8N ou similares.

Diferenciais: Participação em projetos de automação IA (Chatgpt, Gemini,Grok, etc).

Capacidade de propor soluções de ponta e trazer visão estratégica para o uso de IA na empresa.


Quais serão os seus desafios?

Estruturar e treinar modelos de IA para automação de tarefas repetitivas.

Garantir integração de IA com sistemas jurídicos.

Sustentação a projetos de inovação e demandas corporativas.

Análise de requisitos e desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas eficientes, atuando diretamente na manutenção de sistemas e aplicações da empresa.

Atuar na análise de necessidades propondo soluções de automações sistêmicas com IA garantindo governança, qualidade, rastreabilidade e disponibilidade dos dados.

Apoiar a evolução da plataforma de dados, definindo boas práticas, padrões e automações.

Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, propondo soluções escaláveis e eficientes para desafios complexos de dados.

Desenvolver scripts ou manipulação de dados para melhoria sistêmica e/ou segurança dos dados.

Sustentação e manutenção de softwares de ERP e HCM, incluindo customizações e suporte a usuários finais.


Engenheiro de Dados Pleno (BI):

  • Experiência em modelagem, arquitetura e integração de múltiplas fontes (ERP, CRM, APIs, bancos relacionais e não relacionais).
  • Domínio de SQL e boas práticas de performance, particionamento e tuning.
  • Experiência com Python e SQL, além de trabalhar bem com frameworks de processamento como Spark, Databricks, Airflow ou equivalentes.
  • Vivência na construção de pipelines escaláveis e de alto desempenho, com práticas modernas de versionamento, testes e CI/CD.
  • Atuação na criação de estruturas para Data Warehouse, Data Lake ou LakehouseExperiência com serviços em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Expertise em Business Intelligence: modelagem dimensional, fatos/dimensões, métricas, KPIs e governança de relatórios.
  • Experiência com plataformas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou similares), garantindo dados consistentes e de qualidade.


Diferenciais: Atuação anterior na definição de arquitetura de BI corporativa ou padronização de métricas/KPIs estratégicas.

Construção de soluções analíticas avançadas, como dashboards preditivos, métricas automatizadas ou integrações com APIs internas e externas.

Experiência com Snowflake ou outros cloud data warehouses;


Quais serão os seus desafios?

Desenvolver integrações entres sistemas jurídicos e plataformas internas.

Preparação de bases para criação de um data lake.

Garantir padronização e confiabilidade de dados.

Apoiar projetos de BI e advanced analytics.

Sustentação a projetos de inovação e demandas corporativas.

Análise de requisitos e desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas eficientes, atuando diretamente na manutenção de sistemas e aplicações da

empresa.

Projetar, construir e evoluir pipelines de dados que

suportem dashboards, análises e produtos de dados de alta confiabilidade.

Atuar como referência técnica para BI, ajudando a definir melhores práticas, padrões de modelagem e governança.

Apoiar áreas internas a interpretar dados, propor melhorias e transformar necessidades em soluções escaláveis.

Participar da evolução da plataforma de dados, trazendo visão crítica para otimização de performance, segurança e custos.


Quais serão as suas recompensas?


MUITAS, queremos todos felizes e realizados!

Vale refeição;

Descontos em restaurantes parceiros;

Vale transporte;

Plano de saúde;

Plano odontológico;

Bolsa de estudos;

PPR;

Seguro de vida;

Prêmio por tempo de casa;

Folga de aniversário;

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Hiring: Cloud Engineer (GCP / AWS / Python / AVID MAM)

Location: Remote / Hybrid (based on region)

Experience Level: Mid–Senior


About the Role


We are looking for a skilled Cloud Engineer with strong experience across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, Python development, and workflow migration. The ideal candidate will also have hands-on expertise with AVID Media Asset Management (MAM) systems and the ability to support modern CI/CD deployment practices.


This role involves cloud-based workflow modernization, application and media workflow migration, automation scripting, and integration across cloud environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Design, implement, and support solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and AWS.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and integrations using Python.
  • Lead or support workflow migration initiatives from legacy systems to cloud-native architectures.
  • Work with AVID MAM systems for media workflow integration, configuration, and automation support.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support continuous deployment and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, media operations, DevOps) to design efficient and scalable solutions.
  • Troubleshoot cloud-based applications, media workflows, and infrastructure issues.


Required Skills & Experience


  • Strong hands-on expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with AWS services, cloud deployment models, and cross-cloud integration.
  • Proficiency in Python for automation, scripting, data processing, or workflow integration.
  • Proven experience in workflow migration (media workflows preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • AVID MAM (Avid Media Asset Management) experience is mandatory.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, optimize, and document cloud and media workflows.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team.


Nice to Have


  • Experience with media workflows, broadcast systems, or video delivery platforms.
  • Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with storage, CDN, streaming, or metadata management in cloud environments.

title: Bilingual Account Coordinator
description:
Are you the kind of person who thrives in the center of the action: keeping customers happy, teams aligned, and problems solved before they even arise? We’re looking for an Account Coordinator who’s proactive, detail-obsessed, and fueled by customer satisfaction.


In this role, you’ll be the glue between our clients, field teams, and leadership. Making sure every call, installation, and email ends with a 5-star smile from our client and customer.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own the 5-star customer experience: satisfaction isn’t enough, we go for exceeded expectations
  • Manage calls with customers and technicians, keeping the flow smooth and the tone friendly
  • Schedule, confirm, or reschedule installations like a logistics magician
  • Notify customers of their time windows and make sure everyone’s in the know
  • Send routes and job assignments to technicians for the next day
  • Call techs for ETA updates and relay real-time info to customers
  • Respond to emails and assist incoming calls when needed: stay sharp and helpful
  • Handle escalated situations with confidence, empathy, and a calm voice
  • Maintain communication with clients and business partners to ensure alignment


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years in customer service roles (bonus points for field-service coordination)
  • Advanced English fluency (C1 or C2 level): you’re confident on the phone and in writing
  • Able to juggle tasks like a pro while staying positive and focused
  • Independent and highly responsible: you don’t wait to be told, you do


Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting American clients or companies
  • Proven leadership in previous roles: if you’ve guided teams, we’d love to hear about it


Schedule & Setup

  • Hours: 11 AM – 8 PM (California Time / PST)
  • 1-hour break included
  • Fully remote: work from anywhere, but your setup must support success
  • 1-week PTO after the first year working with us


Tech Requirements

  • A reliable computer with fast internet
  • Headset with clear mic and strong audio
  • A quiet space: no distractions, just action

  • Experience in open-source contributions or building developer tools.
  • Comfort working in fast-paced, research-driven environments.

title: Account Assistant – Social Creators (Júnior)
description:
A WIP é um estúdio de design de narrativa que une storytelling e branding de forma estratégica, fazendo gestão de criadores e conteúdos para gerar impacto cultural através das marcas. Trabalhamos com métodos proprietários e processos ágeis para desenvolver narrativas e projetos que conectam, engajam e geram valor real.


Sobre o cargo


Como Account Assistant – Social Creators (Júnior), você será responsável por dar suporte ao time na operação do dia a dia com criadores de conteúdo.

O foco da vaga é organização, acompanhamento das entregas e apoio na comunicação com criadores e clientes.


É uma vaga para quem está começando no mercado, gosta do universo de conteúdo e quer aprender rápido sobre influência, redes sociais e rotinas de campanhas.


Responsabilidades principais


  • Dar apoio nas primeiras conversas com criadores (envio de informações, coleta de valores e detalhes básicos);
  • Acompanhar criadores após a contratação (repassar briefings, tirar dúvidas simples, organizar prazos e entregas);
  • Garantir atualização das informações em planilhas e sistemas internos;
  • Ajudar no controle de entregas (roteiros, vídeos, posts, stories, prazos e refações);
  • Fazer checklists, atualizar status e apoiar no envio de materiais para aprovadores;
  • Auxiliar na organização de reuniões, pautas e acompanhamentos;
  • Pesquisar tendências de redes sociais e referências simples para apoiar os projetos;
  • Ajudar no mapeamento inicial de criadores, buscando perfis alinhados ao briefing.


Qualidades esperadas


  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para lidar com pessoas;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes (vai lidar com prazos e muitas informações);
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer no universo de criadores;
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo e com boa gestão de prioridades;
  • Fluência em espanhol (obrigatório).


Ferramentas utilizadas

﻿

  • Influency.me
  • Social Blade
  • TikTok, Instagram, YouTube e Twitch
  • Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive)
  • Canva
  • Monday
  • Slack

Renata Rocha Law, PLLC is a boutique immigration law firm dedicated exclusively to U.S. immigration matters.
