title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior - Node + React
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior - Node + React


*Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


*Nosso cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente que atua no segmento de fabricação e comercialização de eletrodomésticos e eletroportáteis.


*O que buscamos?

Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior com sólida experiência em Node.js, React, SQL, Crons, Docker, Argo CD, Sequelize e TypeORM. O profissional será responsável por um novo projeto.


*O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Node.js, utilizando Sequelize e TypeORM para interação com bancos de dados relacionais.

• Criar e otimizar APIs RESTful e serviços para comunicação entre sistemas.

• Implementar e manter aplicações frontend utilizando React.js e TailwindCSS.

• Criar e gerenciar tarefas agendadas (crons) para automação de processos críticos.

• Implementar e gerenciar containers com Docker e orquestração com Argo CD.

• Desenvolver consultas otimizadas em SQL Server, PostgreSQL ou MySQL.

• Atuar na integração e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD para garantir entregas contínuas e seguras.

• Diagnosticar e corrigir problemas de performance e segurança no backend e frontend.

• Trabalhar com metodologias ágeis, garantindo boas práticas de Clean Code e Design Patterns.


*O que você precisa ter

• Experiência avançada com Node.js (Express, NestJS).

• Experiência com React.js e boas práticas de frontend.

• Conhecimento sólido em bancos SQL e ORM (Sequelize e TypeORM).

• Experiência com criação e gerenciamento de Jobs/crons para automação.

• Conhecimento avançado em Docker para criação e gerenciamento de containers.

• Experiência com orquestração de deploys usando Argo CD.

• Prática com CI/CD e deploys automatizados.

• Boa experiência com integração de APIs e segurança (JWT, OAuth, OpenID).

• Sólidos conhecimentos em estruturas de dados, algoritmos e padrões de arquitetura.


*Diferenciais:

• Experiência com NestJS e arquitetura Clean Code.

• Conhecimento em Kubernetes e infraestrutura como código.

• Experiência com mensageria (Redis).

• Conhecimento em React Native.


Observações:

• Oportunidade para 6 meses iniciais e grande possibilidade de prorrogação.


*Onde você vai trabalhar?

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Híbrido em Curitiba – PR, no Bacacheri. São 3 dias presenciais e 2 remotos. O dia que todos vão presencial é na quarta e os outros 2 dias de presencial o profissional pode escolher. Importante ressaltar que o primeiro mês é 100% presencial para imersão no ambiente, treinamentos e alinhamentos. O híbrido se aplica a partir do mês subsequente.

title: Bilingual Account Coordinator
description:
Are you the kind of person who thrives in the center of the action: keeping customers happy, teams aligned, and problems solved before they even arise? We’re looking for an Account Coordinator who’s proactive, detail-obsessed, and fueled by customer satisfaction.


In this role, you’ll be the glue between our clients, field teams, and leadership. Making sure every call, installation, and email ends with a 5-star smile from our client and customer.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own the 5-star customer experience: satisfaction isn’t enough, we go for exceeded expectations
  • Manage calls with customers and technicians, keeping the flow smooth and the tone friendly
  • Schedule, confirm, or reschedule installations like a logistics magician
  • Notify customers of their time windows and make sure everyone’s in the know
  • Send routes and job assignments to technicians for the next day
  • Call techs for ETA updates and relay real-time info to customers
  • Respond to emails and assist incoming calls when needed: stay sharp and helpful
  • Handle escalated situations with confidence, empathy, and a calm voice
  • Maintain communication with clients and business partners to ensure alignment


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years in customer service roles (bonus points for field-service coordination)
  • Advanced English fluency (C1 or C2 level): you’re confident on the phone and in writing
  • Able to juggle tasks like a pro while staying positive and focused
  • Independent and highly responsible: you don’t wait to be told, you do


Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting American clients or companies
  • Proven leadership in previous roles: if you’ve guided teams, we’d love to hear about it


Schedule & Setup

  • Hours: 11 AM – 8 PM (California Time / PST)
  • 1-hour break included
  • Fully remote: work from anywhere, but your setup must support success
  • 1-week PTO after the first year working with us


Tech Requirements

  • A reliable computer with fast internet
  • Headset with clear mic and strong audio
  • A quiet space: no distractions, just action

title: Account Assistant – Social Creators (Júnior)
description:
A WIP é um estúdio de design de narrativa que une storytelling e branding de forma estratégica, fazendo gestão de criadores e conteúdos para gerar impacto cultural através das marcas. Trabalhamos com métodos proprietários e processos ágeis para desenvolver narrativas e projetos que conectam, engajam e geram valor real.


Sobre o cargo


Como Account Assistant – Social Creators (Júnior), você será responsável por dar suporte ao time na operação do dia a dia com criadores de conteúdo.

O foco da vaga é organização, acompanhamento das entregas e apoio na comunicação com criadores e clientes.


É uma vaga para quem está começando no mercado, gosta do universo de conteúdo e quer aprender rápido sobre influência, redes sociais e rotinas de campanhas.


Responsabilidades principais


  • Dar apoio nas primeiras conversas com criadores (envio de informações, coleta de valores e detalhes básicos);
  • Acompanhar criadores após a contratação (repassar briefings, tirar dúvidas simples, organizar prazos e entregas);
  • Garantir atualização das informações em planilhas e sistemas internos;
  • Ajudar no controle de entregas (roteiros, vídeos, posts, stories, prazos e refações);
  • Fazer checklists, atualizar status e apoiar no envio de materiais para aprovadores;
  • Auxiliar na organização de reuniões, pautas e acompanhamentos;
  • Pesquisar tendências de redes sociais e referências simples para apoiar os projetos;
  • Ajudar no mapeamento inicial de criadores, buscando perfis alinhados ao briefing.


Qualidades esperadas


  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para lidar com pessoas;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes (vai lidar com prazos e muitas informações);
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer no universo de criadores;
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo e com boa gestão de prioridades;
  • Fluência em espanhol (obrigatório).


Ferramentas utilizadas

﻿

  • Influency.me
  • Social Blade
  • TikTok, Instagram, YouTube e Twitch
  • Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive)
  • Canva
  • Monday
  • Slack

title: Account Assistant – Social Creators (Júnior)
description:

Como Account Assistant – Social Creators (Júnior), você será responsável por dar suporte ao time na operação do dia a dia com criadores de conteúdo.

title: Intake Specialist
description:
Company Description

Renata Rocha Law, PLLC is a boutique immigration law firm dedicated exclusively to U.S. immigration matters. Founded by Renata Rocha, a licensed attorney in both the U.S. and Brazil, the firm provides personalized, ethical, and strategic legal services to a diverse clientele. With a client-centered approach, the firm is committed to guiding individuals through their immigration journey with clarity, security, and professionalism. Renata Rocha Law is passionate about advocating for clients and supporting them in achieving their American dream with exceptional service and legal expertise.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote position for a Legal Intake Specialist. The Legal Intake Specialist will be responsible for managing initial client interactions to gather necessary information, conducting client intake processes, and ensuring a positive client experience during their first point of contact. Daily tasks include responding to inquiries, collecting essential documentation, scheduling consultations, and maintaining accurate records. This role also requires collaboration with the legal team to ensure effective case handling and a smooth transition for clients into the legal process.


Qualifications

  • Strong Communication and Interpersonal Skills to engage effectively with diverse individuals
  • Experience in Client Intake and Customer Service to manage inquiries, gather information, and provide exceptional client support
  • Experience with immigration law or legal/immigration procedures is a plus
  • Attention to detail and the ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality
  • Proficiency with digital tools, case management software, and remote communication platforms
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English is required, and the candidate must be able to communicate in Spanish
  • Must be able to work full time, Monday through Friday, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Eastern Time – U.S.)



Send your resume to:

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a DevOps / Technical Support Engineer to support a development team working on the internationalization and maintenance of a large-scale e-commerce platform. The environment consists of a distributed microservices architecture deployed on on-premises Kubernetes clusters and virtual machines , requiring hands-on troubleshooting, deployment operations, and strong coordination with engineering teams and clients. This role is highly technical and involves active participation in English-speaking client meetings and collaboration across multiple teams.


Responsibilities

  • Support the development team responsible for translating and adapting a distributed microservices e-commerce platform.
  • Manage and troubleshoot Kubernetes microservice deployments using Helm charts.
  • Operate and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines; diagnose and resolve failures in automated deployment processes.
  • Collaborate closely with Java and Python development teams to understand deployment requirements.
  • Troubleshoot client ecosystem tools based on Jenkins self-service pipelines.
  • Support backend technologies such as PostgreSQL and Kafka, handling configuration, connectivity, and integration issues.
  • Retrieve and analyze logs from Kubernetes pods and on-prem VMs using Grafana, ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), and Jenkins logs.
  • Participate in English-speaking client meetings to gather requirements, clarify needs, and provide updates.
  • Manage work using a Kanban workflow.
  • Contribute to improvements in deployment processes, documentation, monitoring, and troubleshooting procedures.


Required Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, and containerized deployments in on-premise environments.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, especially Jenkins.
  • Basic to intermediate experience with microservices written in Java and Python.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL and Kafka.
  • Ability to diagnose distributed system issues using logs, dashboards, and monitoring tools (Grafana, ELK, etc.).
  • Experience with on-premises infrastructure.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to participate confidently in English-speaking client meetings.
  • Experience with Agile/Kanban methodologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in complex environments.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting legacy systems built in Java.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with large enterprise e-commerce platforms.
  • Knowledge of networking, authentication, and authorization concepts.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash or Python.
  • Experience with Groovy for Jenkins Pipeline-as-Code.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

Procuramos profissionais que atuem como AI Engineer para atuação remota.

Desenvolver, arquitetar e implementar soluções de GenAI para grandes contas, incluindo RAG, LLMs, pipelines MLOps, vetorização, avaliações e tuning.

title: Responsable de Ouvidoria
description:
Estamos viviendo una etapa de rápido crecimiento.

description:

Job Title: Business Development Specialist

Location: Remote (Canadian-Based Company)

Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor

Work Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week, EST

Monthly Compensation: $2000–$2500 USD per month (based on experience)


Job Summary

The Business Development Specialist will support two senior leaders within the organization while playing a key role in driving revenue growth, strengthening partner relationships, and ensuring smooth project and account management execution.


In this dual-function role, you will support the SVP of Partnerships (80%) by helping source, build, and manage strategic relationships. Business Development & Account/Partnership Management (80%)

  • Track partnership and account performance metrics; prepare reports as needed.
  • Support project coordination related to partner programs and onboarding.

  • Provide general administrative and organizational support to ensure operational efficiency.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Project Management, Account Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2+ years proven experience in Business Development, Account Management, Partnership Management, or Sales Coordination.
  • Project Management or Account Management certification or diploma is a strong asset (e.g., PMP, CAPM, Scrum, Account Management programs).
  • Familiarity with digital displays, interactive technology, or related digital/tech industries is an advantage (optional).
  • Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects or accounts at once.
  • Experience using CRM tools (Pipedrive preferred) and productivity tools (Google Workspace, Microsoft Office).
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive mindset with eagerness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, evolving environment.


Non-Paid Assessment (If Applicable)

Candidates may be asked to complete a non-paid skills assessment using provided instructions and materials. Thank you for your understanding.

title: Podcast Producer
description:
Podcast Producer (Full-Service Management) – Sofia Health


Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Role


Sofia Health is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Podcast Producer to manage the full production workflow of our weekly interview podcast, Sofia Unfiltered. This role handles guest communication, scheduling, episode preparation, editorial coordination, and project management from pre-production through publishing.


We interview physicians, psychologists, authors, wellness experts, and thought leaders. You must be able to communicate professionally, manage multiple moving pieces, and maintain a calm, supportive tone consistent with our brand.


⭐What You’ll Do (Responsibilities) Guest Communication & Outreach
  • Manage all communication with guests from initial outreach to post-episode follow-up
  • Schedule interviews, send confirmations/reminders, and provide prep materials
  • Collect bios, headshots, books, links, and required release forms
  • Draft guest outreach emails and pitch new guests aligned with upcoming content themes
  • Maintain guest pipeline, schedules, and assets in Notion/Google Drive


Episode Planning & Production
  • Prepare episode briefs and host prep sheets
  • Attend live recordings (optional but preferred) to track timestamps and notes
  • Review raw audio/video and provide clear, detailed edit notes to the editor
  • Restructure episodes when needed for clarity, flow, and narrative arc
  • Collaborate on episode titles, angles, hooks, and story direction
  • Choose main promotional clips and quotes for social content


Editing Coordination
  • Send the editor cut notes that are clear, accurate, and time-stamped
  • Review first edit, request revisions, and ensure quality before publishing
  • Ensure the final episode reflects brand voice, pacing, clarity, and guest experience


Publishing & Show Management
  • Write compelling show notes, descriptions, summaries, and timestamps
  • Prepare publishing assets (titles, tags, categories, episode artwork if needed)
  • Upload weekly episodes to our hosting platform (Spotify for Podcasters or similar)
  • Track episode performance metrics and maintain publishing calendar


Marketing & Promotion Support
  • Coordinate with the social media team to deliver clips, quotes, and captions
  • Identify promotional opportunities through guests’ audiences
  • Support the creation of audiograms, reels, and short-form content briefs


Monetization & Growth
  • Assist in creating sponsorship decks and packages
  • Research relevant brand partners to pitch
  • Coordinate guest cross-promotion to increase downloads
  • Identify podcast swaps and collaboration opportunities
  • Track growth trends and propose strategies to expand reach


Host & Media Outreach (Podcast Guest Booking)


  • Research aligned podcasts across wellness, entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership, mental health, women’s health, lifestyle medicine, and business growth
  • Create a list of high-quality podcasts suitable for Riley as a guest
  • Draft personalized podcast pitches in Riley’s voice
  • Send and manage outreach emails to podcast hosts and producers
  • Track outreach, follow-ups, and confirmed appearances in Notion or a CRM
  • Coordinate scheduling, prep materials, and talking points
  • Prepare Riley with a one-sheet, interview brief, and relevant episodes of the host
  • Identify opportunities for backlinks, newsletter swaps, and co-marketing
  • Track results and optimize pitches based on acceptance rates



You’re a Great Fit If You…


  • Have real podcast producing experience (required—not entry-level)
  • Have excellent written English and can write in a warm, professional tone
  • Are organized and reliable with strong project management skills
  • Love structure, systems, checklists, and keeping details tight
  • Can communicate confidently with high-profile guests
  • Can listen to an episode and identify what needs to be cut for clarity and flow
  • Are comfortable giving editors detailed, accurate instructions
  • Enjoy managing timelines, assets, and follow-ups
  • Can work independently and solve problems proactively
  • Are calm under pressure and able to meet weekly deadlines


⭐ Required Skills & Experience
  • 2+ years experience as a Podcast Producer , Podcast Manager , or similar
  • Experience working with audio/video editors
  • Strong writing and communication skills
  • Ability to review episodes and give editorial direction
  • Experience managing guests and scheduling interviews
  • Familiarity with publishing platforms (Spotify for Podcasters, Buzzsprout, etc.)
  • Strong organizational skills with tools like Notion, Trello, Asana, or Airtable
  • Comfortable coordinating social media assets
  • Ability to work in US time zones when needed


Bonus:

  • Experience with sponsorship outreach or monetization
  • Background in wellness, psychology, health, or coaching content
  • Experience producing long-form interview-style shows
  • Ability to identify clips for short-form video

title: Graphic Designer (Motion)
description:
We’re looking for a Graphic Designer with strong design fundamentals, an eye for storytelling, and the ability to bring visuals to life through motion. You’ll work across social content, digital graphics, brand design, presentations, and motion graphics.

This role is perfect for someone who loves blending design, animation, and smart use of modern tools and AI to create scroll-stopping, brand-aligned content. If you’re detail-oriented, enjoy working across formats, collaborate well with a creative team, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, you’ll fit right in.


What you'll do

  • Design high-quality social media creative, digital graphics, presentations, and branded visual systems across multiple formats and platforms.
  • Create motion graphics and animated elements — including transitions, text animations, graphics packages, and lightweight video edits for short-form content.
  • Apply brand guidelines consistently while finding space for creativity and innovation.
  • Use AI and modern creative tools to speed up ideation, design variations, motion workflows, and content exploration.
  • Collaborate with creative leads and project managers to clarify briefs, address feedback and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Maintain clean, organised files and a high standard of craft across motion and static work.


What you'll bring

  • 2+ years of experience as a Graphic Designer, Motion Designer, or hybrid creative role.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing brand design, social content, motion graphics, and layout expertise.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and strong working knowledge of Figma and presentation design tools.
  • Understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, colour systems, and brand identity.
  • Ability to animate and design for modern platforms (Reels, TikTok, YouTube, paid social, etc).
  • Familiarity with AI or automation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Runway and Midjourney).
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with tight timelines and evolving briefs.
  • A collaborative mindset, strong attention to detail, and an ability to embrace and act on feedback.
  • Clear and confident communication in English, with the ability to explain design decisions and collaborate effectively with both creatives and project managers.


Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency, and creativity. Our workflow is built for momentum — pairing great talent with streamlined processes, smart tech and a global, supportive team.


At SoCreative, you’ll have the chance to:

  • Work with ambitious brands across video, design, and motion formats.
  • Collaborate with world-class creatives around the globe.
  • Grow quickly in a company shaping how modern creative production works.
  • Take ownership of your work and contribute meaningfully to projects that move fast and have real impact.

title: Ecommerce Specialist (Remote)
description:
Who we are

We are a fashion-forward housewares company looking for the best and brightest to join our talented team. We pride ourselves on bringing high-quality products to market, creating an excellent and rewarding work environment, and constantly striving for growth and improvement.

We manufacture and sell kitchenware, hydration, and everyday products through retailers of all sizes — from major national chains to independent specialty shops across the U.S. and internationally. Over the past 15 years, we’ve built an incredible, diverse team across multiple global offices. As our Ecommerce business continues to scale, we are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Ecommerce Specialist to support our Amazon and Shopify operations.

Who you are

You are a highly organized and execution-focused ecommerce professional who can work in a fast-paced environment and follow established processes with accuracy. You have hands-on experience building and updating product listings, managing catalog data, and supporting marketplace operations. You take ownership of your work, demonstrate strong attention to detail, and are comfortable coordinating with cross-functional teams across time zones.

You enjoy problem-solving, working with spreadsheets, improving product detail pages, monitoring catalog health, and supporting advertising and inventory workflows. You are dependable, proactive, and looking for a long-term opportunity to grow within an established and rapidly expanding ecommerce team.

The role

We are hiring a remote Ecommerce Specialist to support our Amazon and Shopify businesses. In this role, you will be responsible for creating and updating product listings, managing catalog accuracy, preparing inventory and replenishment reports, coordinating content updates and photoshoots, and supporting day-to-day marketplace operations.

You will collaborate closely with our U.S. Ecommerce Manager, Photography, Product Development, Marketing, and Graphic Design teams to ensure that listings are built correctly, content follows brand guidelines, and catalog data remains clean and consistent. You will monitor listing quality, help troubleshoot issues in Seller Central and Shopify, support FBA replenishment workflows, and assist in maintaining advertising campaigns using established processes and templates.

This role is ideal for someone who is organized, process-driven, detail-oriented, and eager to contribute to a fast-growing ecommerce department.

Responsibilities

  • Create and update product listings on Amazon and Shopify using Excel templates and brand guidelines
  • Ensure catalog accuracy across SKUs, variations, attributes, images, pricing and keywords
  • Monitor listings for suppressions, errors, and missing attributes and resolve issues promptly
  • Manage and replenish FBA inventory using replenishment suggestions and product sell through
  • Review sales trends, product data, and competitor listings to identify opportunities for improvement
  • Update product detail pages, A+ content, and brand stores using creative assets provided by internal teams
  • Assist with pay-per-click advertising workflows including keyword updates, bulk uploads, and campaign maintenance
  • Prepare weekly reports on sales, inventory, pricing, and catalog health
  • Open, track, and follow up on support cases within Amazon Seller Central
  • Coordinate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of ecommerce operations
  • Daily check-ins with Ecommerce Manager for prioritization and progress updates

Skills and Experience

  • 1-3+ years of experience working with Amazon Seller Central and Shopify Admin
  • Strong proficiency in Excel (VLOOKUP, filters, formatting, data organization)
  • Familiarity with FBA processes, inventory management, and catalog troubleshooting
  • Experience with PPC workflows (bulk uploads, keyword harvesting, campaign edits)
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to follow SOPs, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines
  • Strong written English and communication skills
  • Self-motivated, dependable, and able to work independently with remote teams
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities


Salary: BRL R$42,000 – R$78,000 / year

title: Líder de Projetos - SAP (ABAP/BW)
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Líder de Projetos — Equipes SAP ABAP e BW


Remoto - Brasil.

Horário - Comercial.


Procuramos profissional experiente para conduzir e desenvolver equipes SAP ABAP e BW. Profissional focado em liderança técnica, governança de entregas e capacitação de times, que será o ponto focal de sustentação e projetos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Mapear competências técnicas e gaps da equipe, identificando planos de desenvolvimento individuais;
  • Promover e estruturar a fábrica de ABAP, definindo processos, padrões e boas práticas;
  • Definir, implantar e acompanhar o programa de capacitação e certificação das equipes;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de profissionais em início de carreira e de novos consultores, garantindo ramp-up eficiente;
  • Organizar a cobertura de férias, assegurando continuidade das entregas;
  • Acompanhar e garantir o apontamento correto de horas e conformidade com políticas internas;
  • Apoiar processos de contratação e desligamento de consultores, em alinhamento com RH;
  • Atuar como ponto focal para suporte técnico às equipes de sustentação e para demandas de projetos;
  • Colaborar com a gerência e stakeholders para priorização de demandas e mitigação de riscos técnicos.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes técnicas SAP ABAP e BW;
  • Habilidade em mapear competências, estruturar equipes e implantar programas de capacitação;
  • Experiência na organização de cobertura de férias, gestão de apontamento de horas e suporte a processos de contratação/desligamento;
  • Boa comunicação com stakeholders e capacidade de atuar como ponto focal entre sustentação e projetos;
  • Excelentes conhecimento técnico em SAP ABAP (PI/PO, BTP, Workflow e Integrações);
  • Experiência prática com SAP BW (modelos, extração/transformação, carregamento e performance);
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis e governança de fábrica de desenvolvimento;
  • Graduação completa.


Qualificações desejáveis:

  • Familiaridade com BASIS;
  • Experiência anterior em estruturação de programas de treinamento/capacitação/bootcamps;
  • Certificações SAP e/ou experiência em projetos de grande porte;
  • Inglês intermediário.


Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação;
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de remuneração variável;
  • Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade;

  • Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos;
  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional

  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa);
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas);
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas);
  • Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

  • Terapia online;

title: Ecommerce Specialist (Remote)
description:
Who we are

We are a fashion-forward housewares company looking for the best and brightest to join our talented team. We pride ourselves on bringing high-quality products to market, creating an excellent and rewarding work environment, and constantly striving for growth and improvement.

We manufacture and sell kitchenware, hydration, and everyday products through retailers of all sizes — from major national chains to independent specialty shops across the U.S. and internationally. Over the past 15 years, we’ve built an incredible, diverse team across multiple global offices. As our Ecommerce business continues to scale, we are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Ecommerce Specialist to support our Amazon and Shopify operations.

Who you are

You are a highly organized and execution-focused ecommerce professional who can work in a fast-paced environment and follow established processes with accuracy. You have hands-on experience building and updating product listings, managing catalog data, and supporting marketplace operations. You take ownership of your work, demonstrate strong attention to detail, and are comfortable coordinating with cross-functional teams across time zones.

You enjoy problem-solving, working with spreadsheets, improving product detail pages, monitoring catalog health, and supporting advertising and inventory workflows. You are dependable, proactive, and looking for a long-term opportunity to grow within an established and rapidly expanding ecommerce team.

The role

We are hiring a remote Ecommerce Specialist to support our Amazon and Shopify businesses. In this role, you will be responsible for creating and updating product listings, managing catalog accuracy, preparing inventory and replenishment reports, coordinating content updates and photoshoots, and supporting day-to-day marketplace operations.

You will collaborate closely with our U.S. Ecommerce Manager, Photography, Product Development, Marketing, and Graphic Design teams to ensure that listings are built correctly, content follows brand guidelines, and catalog data remains clean and consistent. You will monitor listing quality, help troubleshoot issues in Seller Central and Shopify, support FBA replenishment workflows, and assist in maintaining advertising campaigns using established processes and templates.

This role is ideal for someone who is organized, process-driven, detail-oriented, and eager to contribute to a fast-growing ecommerce department.

Responsibilities

  • Create and update product listings on Amazon and Shopify using Excel templates and brand guidelines
  • Ensure catalog accuracy across SKUs, variations, attributes, images, pricing and keywords
  • Monitor listings for suppressions, errors, and missing attributes and resolve issues promptly
  • Manage and replenish FBA inventory using replenishment suggestions and product sell through
  • Review sales trends, product data, and competitor listings to identify opportunities for improvement
  • Update product detail pages, A+ content, and brand stores using creative assets provided by internal teams
  • Assist with pay-per-click advertising workflows including keyword updates, bulk uploads, and campaign maintenance
  • Prepare weekly reports on sales, inventory, pricing, and catalog health
  • Open, track, and follow up on support cases within Amazon Seller Central
  • Coordinate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of ecommerce operations
  • Daily check-ins with Ecommerce Manager for prioritization and progress updates

Skills and Experience

  • 1-3+ years of experience working with Amazon Seller Central and Shopify Admin
  • Strong proficiency in Excel (VLOOKUP, filters, formatting, data organization)
  • Familiarity with FBA processes, inventory management, and catalog troubleshooting
  • Experience with PPC workflows (bulk uploads, keyword harvesting, campaign edits)
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to follow SOPs, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines
  • Strong written English and communication skills
  • Self-motivated, dependable, and able to work independently with remote teams
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities


Salary: BRL R$42,000 – R$78,000 / year

REMOTE POSITION

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Ecommerce Growth Consulting & Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses attract, engage, and convert their ideal audience.

Our Mission: to help DTC ecommerce companies grow holistically

Our Vision: We imagine a world where service businesses never have to worry about meeting revenue goals, attracting consistent quality customers, retaining customers, or maintaining and growing their overall online presence.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated

- Pay close attention to detail 

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator

- Confidence and determination to achieve our vision.


Who We Are Looking For:


We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.


The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.


The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.


Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
  • Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
  • Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
  • Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
  • Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
  • Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
  • Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.


Compensation:

  • $2000 - $5000 USD per month

title: Pricing Specialist
description:
About Us

We are a growing freight brokerage and transportation company specializing in time-sensitive, temperature-controlled, and high-touch shipments across the U.S. We work with shippers in industries such as medical, artwork, hazmat, and white-glove services, and we pride ourselves on being responsive, reliable, and solutions-oriented.

We’re looking for a Pricing Specialist to own our day-to-day quoting and pricing strategy, helping us win profitable freight while maintaining strong carrier relationships.


Key Responsibilities

Spot & Contract Pricing

  • Prepare spot quotes for truckload, LTL, reefer, flatbed, and specialty shipments in a fast-paced environment.
  • Analyze customer RFQs/RFPs and build competitive, profitable pricing proposals.
  • Maintain and update pricing matrices, lane guides, and rate tables.

Market & Lane Analysis

  • Monitor daily market conditions (capacity, seasonality, fuel, regional trends) and adjust pricing accordingly.
  • Analyze historical data by lane, customer, and mode to set target margins and identify opportunities.
  • Recommend pricing strategies for new lanes, customers, and verticals.

Collaboration with Sales & Operations

  • Partner with the sales team to support new business opportunities and respond quickly to customer quote requests.
  • Work closely with carrier procurement/operations to understand true cost on lanes, including repositioning, deadhead, and accessorial.
  • Provide clear pricing logic and talking points so the sales team can confidently present rates to customers.

Margin & Performance Management

  • Track win rates, margins, and quote response times, and suggest improvements based on data.
  • Flag unprofitable lanes and customers and propose revised pricing or alternative solutions.
  • Build and maintain dashboards or reports for leadership (e.g., by lane, mode, customer).
  • Tools & Process Improvement
  • Use TMS, load boards, and market data tools to benchmark rates and build accurate quotes.
  • Help refine internal pricing workflows, templates, and SLAs to speed up response times and improve accuracy.


Requirements

Experience

  • 2–5+ years of pricing, carrier procurement, or operations experience in a freight brokerage or 3PL environment.
  • Strong understanding of truckload and/or LTL pricing, including fuel, accessorial, detention, and layover.

title: Creative Production Lead
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!

﻿

About Olly Olly

Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we're blending technology and real-world expertise to empower small businesses across the U.S. like never before.


We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That's why we're on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high-quality leads, get calls and reviews, and grow sustainably without the hassle.


The Olly Olly platform complements our hands-on service perfectly: it's no-nonsense, easy-to-use software that helps local businesses streamline operations, drive leads, and maximize revenue with minimal effort so they can focus on what they do best.


Why We Need You

You have the eye. You can look at a website for five seconds and know whether it builds trust or destroys it. You see the logo that looks like a 2008 Fiverr special, the stock photo that screams "we didn't try," the typography that signals cheap. And it bothers you. Physically.


We're building a production team that creates websites, logos, and visual assets for 4,000+ local service businesses—contractors, plumbers, attorneys, HVAC companies. These businesses live or die by how professional they look online. Your job is to make sure everything we ship makes them look like the best option in their market.


As Creative Production Lead , you'll manage a team of designers who assemble websites from content, photos, and structured data. You're not just assigning tickets. You're inspecting work daily, catching the details that kill credibility, coaching your team to see what you see, and refusing to let "good enough" out the door.


You can also DO the work yourself. When a logo needs to be created or fixed, you're not waiting for someone else. When a layout isn't working, you can open the file and make it better. You lead by example because you're a designer first, manager second.


The Impact You'll Have

  • Quality is your obsession. You review completed work daily—not for completion, but for excellence. You catch the weak logo, the amateur photo crop, the layout that buries the CTA, the color palette that feels dated. Nothing ships unless it meets your standards.
  • You inspect, you coach, you elevate. You're providing specific feedback on real work: "This logo doesn't work because the type is fighting the icon." "This hero image undermines trust—the lighting looks fake." "This layout guides the eye away from what matters." You're building your team's taste through detailed critiques.
  • You stay fluid. What looked great two years ago looks tired today. You're constantly studying what's working across industries, updating standards, killing approaches that stopped converting. When you spot a pattern that works, you train the team on it immediately.
  • You execute when needed. Logo needs a refresh? You can do it. Layout falling apart? You fix it. You're not above the work—you're the best at it.
  • You run production, not a gallery. This is high-volume. Your team handles hundreds of sites and thousands of updates monthly. You understand that speed and quality aren't opposites—they require discipline, systems, and people who give a damn.


What We Really Need From You

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years in visual design with a portfolio that demonstrates genuine taste—not just competence, but an eye for what converts vs. what just exists
  • 2+ years leading or managing a design team—you've held people to standards, given hard feedback, and developed talent
  • Hands-on execution skills: you can create and refine logos, fix layouts, improve visual hierarchy yourself
  • Production experience: you've worked in environments where volume mattered—agencies, e-commerce, high-output teams
  • Quality obsession: you reject work that's "fine" because fine doesn't win


What Would Be Big Pluses

  • Background in advertising, branding agencies, or e-commerce design
  • Experience with WordPress page builders (Elementor, WP Bakery, Divi, Gutenberg)—or willingness to learn fast
  • Understanding of conversion principles: what builds trust, what drives action
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems
  • Knowledge of SEO basics and how design choices impact performance


We'll teach you:

  • Our specific tools and workflows
  • WordPress/Elementor if you don't know them (you'll pick it up in a week)
  • Our brand guidelines and quality standards
  • The local service business landscape


What You'll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Salary: Competitive (based on experience and location)
  • Flexible work: 100% remote, core hours 8 AM – 5 PM EST for collaboration
  • Work-life balance: 15 vacation days + U.S. holidays
  • Growth path: This role leads to Director of Creative Production or VP of Creative. You'll build the team, the systems, and the culture.
  • Real impact: Your standards directly determine whether 17,000+ small businesses look like winners or also-rans.


Why Choose Us?

We're evolving from template-driven agency work to genuinely differentiated design. You'll build a team culture where craft matters, where mediocrity gets rejected, and where the work actually helps small businesses compete.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here—and your unique perspective helps us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Junior founding engineer
description:
The mission

Every year, over a million people move to the US on work visas. They're smart, ambitious, and excited—and then they land and realize the US is no longer made for newcomers.

It's overwhelming. The information is scattered across government websites, Reddit threads, and outdated blog posts. Every situation is slightly different, and one wrong step can cost weeks.

SettleKit fixes this. We're building an app that guides immigrants through US settlement step-by-step and use AI to automate it.


We're early-stage and have multi-year runway. We need a salaried Founding Engineer to help us build this.


The role

You'll be our primary full-time engineer, working directly with me (Max, co-founder). We're a small team—you'll have real ownership from day one:


  • Building features end-to-end. Our app is React on the frontend, Node.js/Express on the backend, PostgreSQL via (currently) Supabase.
  • Working on our AI research pipeline. We use LLMs to generate workflow content from source documents
  • Thinking, not just executing


What's next for SettleKit and You

Right now, the app is in closed beta. Here's where we're heading:

  • AI-powered actions. We want to go beyond telling users what to do. Think: AI that helps fill out government forms, generates document checklists, or drafts emails to employers...
  • Mobile app. Vs. today's webapp
  • Broader coverage


What we're looking for

1. Must have:

  • Experience with graph-based, tree, or conditional logic systems—our core product is a decision graph that adapts to each user's situation
  • 2+ years building with React and Node.js (or similar full-stack experience)
  • Comfortable with TypeScript and SQL
  • You've shipped real products
  • Strong communication in English—we work async-first
  • Based in Latin America (Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, or similar)—we're focused on LATAM for timezone overlap with NYC and the strong engineering talent in the region

2. Nice to have:

  • Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude)
  • Mobile development experience (React Native or native iOS/Android)
  • You've seen immigration complexity firsthand, or know people who have

3. What matters more than credentials:

  • You figure things out
  • You write clean code
  • You're excited about the mission


Why this role

  • Founding team. You'll work directly with the founder. Your code ships to real users immediately
  • Build something that matters. Immigration is broken. Help doctors, scientists, engineers, ... settle fast in the US so they can focus on their life and work
  • Learn by building production AI systems. You'll get hands-on experience building real LLM-powered products
  • (Almost) no AI slop. The product has so far been developed by human engineers, supported by Cursor/Claude
  • Compensation: Full-time salaried position, above market rate depending on experience.

title: Pricing Specialist
description:
About Us

We are a growing freight brokerage and transportation company specializing in time-sensitive, temperature-controlled, and high-touch shipments across the U.S. We work with shippers in industries such as medical, artwork, hazmat, and white-glove services, and we pride ourselves on being responsive, reliable, and solutions-oriented.

We’re looking for a Pricing Specialist to own our day-to-day quoting and pricing strategy, helping us win profitable freight while maintaining strong carrier relationships.


Key Responsibilities

Spot & Contract Pricing

  • Prepare spot quotes for truckload, LTL, reefer, flatbed, and specialty shipments in a fast-paced environment.
  • Analyze customer RFQs/RFPs and build competitive, profitable pricing proposals.
  • Maintain and update pricing matrices, lane guides, and rate tables.

Market & Lane Analysis

  • Monitor daily market conditions (capacity, seasonality, fuel, regional trends) and adjust pricing accordingly.
  • Analyze historical data by lane, customer, and mode to set target margins and identify opportunities.
  • Recommend pricing strategies for new lanes, customers, and verticals.

Collaboration with Sales & Operations

  • Partner with the sales team to support new business opportunities and respond quickly to customer quote requests.
  • Work closely with carrier procurement/operations to understand true cost on lanes, including repositioning, deadhead, and accessorial.
  • Provide clear pricing logic and talking points so the sales team can confidently present rates to customers.

Margin & Performance Management

  • Track win rates, margins, and quote response times, and suggest improvements based on data.
  • Flag unprofitable lanes and customers and propose revised pricing or alternative solutions.
  • Build and maintain dashboards or reports for leadership (e.g., by lane, mode, customer).
  • Tools & Process Improvement
  • Use TMS, load boards, and market data tools to benchmark rates and build accurate quotes.
  • Help refine internal pricing workflows, templates, and SLAs to speed up response times and improve accuracy.


Requirements

Experience

  • 2–5+ years of pricing, carrier procurement, or operations experience in a freight brokerage or 3PL environment.
  • Strong understanding of truckload and/or LTL pricing, including fuel, accessorial, detention, and layover.

Skills

  • Strong English communication skills (writing and speaking) are required. Day-to-day work and communication with our team and customers is in English.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (lookups, pivot tables, basic modeling).
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into clear pricing recommendations.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • High sense of urgency and ability to handle a high volume of quote requests with tight deadlines.

Other

  • Must be based in Colombia, Brazil, Argentina, or Mexico (or nearby LATAM country with similar time zone).
  • Comfortable working remotely and independently, with accountability for results.
  • Able to on Eastern Time hours.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with major TMS platforms and load boards (e.g., DAT, Truckstop, etc.).
  • Prior exposure to temperature-controlled, white glove, hazmat, or airport/air freight-related freight.
  • Experience responding to large RFPs or managing contract bids for enterprise customers.

title: Podcast Producer
description:
Podcast Producer (Full-Service Management) – Sofia Health


Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Role


Sofia Health is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Podcast Producer to manage the full production workflow of our weekly interview podcast, Sofia Unfiltered. This role handles guest communication, scheduling, episode preparation, editorial coordination, and project management from pre-production through publishing.


We interview physicians, psychologists, authors, wellness experts, and thought leaders. You must be able to communicate professionally, manage multiple moving pieces, and maintain a calm, supportive tone consistent with our brand.


⭐What You’ll Do (Responsibilities) Guest Communication & Outreach
  • Manage all communication with guests from initial outreach to post-episode follow-up
  • Schedule interviews, send confirmations/reminders, and provide prep materials
  • Collect bios, headshots, books, links, and required release forms
  • Draft guest outreach emails and pitch new guests aligned with upcoming content themes
  • Maintain guest pipeline, schedules, and assets in Notion/Google Drive


Episode Planning & Production
  • Prepare episode briefs and host prep sheets
  • Attend live recordings (optional but preferred) to track timestamps and notes
  • Review raw audio/video and provide clear, detailed edit notes to the editor
  • Restructure episodes when needed for clarity, flow, and narrative arc
  • Collaborate on episode titles, angles, hooks, and story direction
  • Choose main promotional clips and quotes for social content


Editing Coordination
  • Send the editor cut notes that are clear, accurate, and time-stamped
  • Review first edit, request revisions, and ensure quality before publishing
  • Ensure the final episode reflects brand voice, pacing, clarity, and guest experience


Publishing & Show Management
  • Write compelling show notes, descriptions, summaries, and timestamps
  • Prepare publishing assets (titles, tags, categories, episode artwork if needed)
  • Upload weekly episodes to our hosting platform (Spotify for Podcasters or similar)
  • Track episode performance metrics and maintain publishing calendar


Marketing & Promotion Support
  • Coordinate with the social media team to deliver clips, quotes, and captions
  • Identify promotional opportunities through guests’ audiences
  • Support the creation of audiograms, reels, and short-form content briefs


Monetization & Growth
  • Assist in creating sponsorship decks and packages
  • Research relevant brand partners to pitch
  • Coordinate guest cross-promotion to increase downloads
  • Identify podcast swaps and collaboration opportunities
  • Track growth trends and propose strategies to expand reach


Host & Media Outreach (Podcast Guest Booking)


  • Research aligned podcasts across wellness, entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership, mental health, women’s health, lifestyle medicine, and business growth
  • Create a list of high-quality podcasts suitable for Riley as a guest
  • Draft personalized podcast pitches in Riley’s voice
  • Send and manage outreach emails to podcast hosts and producers
  • Track outreach, follow-ups, and confirmed appearances in Notion or a CRM
  • Coordinate scheduling, prep materials, and talking points
  • Prepare Riley with a one-sheet, interview brief, and relevant episodes of the host
  • Identify opportunities for backlinks, newsletter swaps, and co-marketing
  • Track results and optimize pitches based on acceptance rates



You’re a Great Fit If You…


  • Have real podcast producing experience (required—not entry-level)
  • Have excellent written English and can write in a warm, professional tone
  • Are organized and reliable with strong project management skills
  • Love structure, systems, checklists, and keeping details tight
  • Can communicate confidently with high-profile guests
  • Can listen to an episode and identify what needs to be cut for clarity and flow
  • Are comfortable giving editors detailed, accurate instructions
  • Enjoy managing timelines, assets, and follow-ups
  • Can work independently and solve problems proactively
  • Are calm under pressure and able to meet weekly deadlines


⭐ Required Skills & Experience
  • 2+ years experience as a Podcast Producer , Podcast Manager , or similar
  • Experience working with audio/video editors
  • Strong writing and communication skills
  • Ability to review episodes and give editorial direction
  • Experience managing guests and scheduling interviews
  • Familiarity with publishing platforms (Spotify for Podcasters, Buzzsprout, etc.)
  • Strong organizational skills with tools like Notion, Trello, Asana, or Airtable
  • Comfortable coordinating social media assets
  • Ability to work in US time zones when needed


Bonus:

  • Experience with sponsorship outreach or monetization
  • Background in wellness, psychology, health, or coaching content
  • Experience producing long-form interview-style shows
  • Ability to identify clips for short-form video

• Comprometimento com prazos e qualidade é essencial.

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.


We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers . This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .


Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.


Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.


If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!


Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.



At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: SAT Maths Tutor - 52580
description:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:

title: Regulatory Officer - Agrochemicals - Relocate to Europe
description:
Regulatory Officer - Agrochemical Sector (International Scope)
 Location: Netherlands (Relocation Support & Visa Sponsorship Provided)

Are you an experienced regulatory professional with a passion for plant science, compliance, and international markets? A global player in the agrochemical and crop protection sector , headquartered in the Netherlands , is seeking an experienced Regulatory Officer to join their team.

This is a permanent, full-time position based in the Netherlands , and the employer offers full visa sponsorship and relocation support for the right candidate.

About the Role

In this pivotal position, you will be responsible for managing the full life-cycle of regulatory affairs, including product registration, dossier submission, and coordination of field and lab trials for a wide portfolio of products such as pesticides, fungicides, herbicides, biopesticides, plant nutrients, and veterinary products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead all activities related to product registration and regulatory compliance across multiple regions (particularly Latin America, Africa, India, and China).

  • Oversee field trial operations and coordinate toxicological and ecotoxicological research across international laboratories.

  • Prepare, edit, and submit registration dossiers to agricultural and health authorities.

  • Represent the company in regulatory committees, as well as in discussions with suppliers and customers.

  • Support patent submissions and the company's regulatory strategy.

  • Ensure progress and compliance of all registration projects in alignment with local legislation.

Your Profile

  • Master's degree or higher in Bioengineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Biology, or a related scientific discipline.

  • Minimum of 8 years' experience in regulatory affairs for pesticides, particularly in Latin America and Africa .

  • At least 3 years' experience working with GLP and non-GLP laboratories

  • Strong analytical skills and a methodical, accurate working style.

  • Excellent project management and communication skills.

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); knowledge of Spanish, Indian or Chinese is a plus.

  • Proficient with MS Office tools.

What's on Offer

  • A dynamic, international role within a growing agrochemical company based in the Netherlands.

  • Full visa sponsorship and relocation support for international applicants.

  • A cooperative, multidisciplinary work environment with significant responsibility and independence.

  • Opportunities for international travel and direct engagement with global regulatory bodies.


If you think this is the right opportunity today, send your application today!

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Ecommerce Growth Consulting & Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses attract, engage, and convert their ideal audience.

Our Mission: to help DTC ecommerce companies grow holistically

Our Vision: We imagine a world where service businesses never have to worry about meeting revenue goals, attracting consistent quality customers, retaining customers, or maintaining and growing their overall online presence.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated

- Pay close attention to detail 

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator

- Confidence and determination to achieve our vision.


Who We Are Looking For:


We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.


The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.


The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.


Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
  • Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
  • Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
  • Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
  • Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
  • Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
  • Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.


Compensation:

  • $2000 - $5000 USD per month

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a DevOps / Technical Support Engineer to support a development team working on the internationalization and maintenance of a large-scale e-commerce platform. The environment consists of a distributed microservices architecture deployed on on-premises Kubernetes clusters and virtual machines , requiring hands-on troubleshooting, deployment operations, and strong coordination with engineering teams and clients. This role is highly technical and involves active participation in English-speaking client meetings and collaboration across multiple teams.


Responsibilities

  • Support the development team responsible for translating and adapting a distributed microservices e-commerce platform.
  • Manage and troubleshoot Kubernetes microservice deployments using Helm charts.
  • Operate and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines; diagnose and resolve failures in automated deployment processes.
  • Collaborate closely with Java and Python development teams to understand deployment requirements.
  • Troubleshoot client ecosystem tools based on Jenkins self-service pipelines.
  • Support backend technologies such as PostgreSQL and Kafka, handling configuration, connectivity, and integration issues.
  • Retrieve and analyze logs from Kubernetes pods and on-prem VMs using Grafana, ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), and Jenkins logs.
  • Participate in English-speaking client meetings to gather requirements, clarify needs, and provide updates.
  • Manage work using a Kanban workflow.
  • Contribute to improvements in deployment processes, documentation, monitoring, and troubleshooting procedures.


Required Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, and containerized deployments in on-premise environments.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, especially Jenkins.
  • Basic to intermediate experience with microservices written in Java and Python.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL and Kafka.
  • Ability to diagnose distributed system issues using logs, dashboards, and monitoring tools (Grafana, ELK, etc.).
  • Experience with on-premises infrastructure.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to participate confidently in English-speaking client meetings.
  • Experience with Agile/Kanban methodologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in complex environments.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting legacy systems built in Java.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with large enterprise e-commerce platforms.
  • Knowledge of networking, authentication, and authorization concepts.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash or Python.
  • Experience with Groovy for Jenkins Pipeline-as-Code.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Pleno I (PDV)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades:

  • Atuar com sustentação dos sistemas de PDV (TOTVS e Casa Magalhães) com foco em suportar as operações de lojas físicas;
  • Atuar, identificar e solucionar problemas de conectividade em lojas, avaliando equipamentos e link;
  • Acionar parceiros de conectividade quando necessário para reestabelecer serviços
  • Atuar, identificar e solucionar problemas de hardware nos PDVs das lojas;

  • Interpretar gráficos de alertas, quando indicadores saem do limite aceitável;
