title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a DevOps / Technical Support Engineer to support a development team working on the internationalization and maintenance of a large-scale e-commerce platform. The environment consists of a distributed microservices architecture deployed on on-premises Kubernetes clusters and virtual machines , requiring hands-on troubleshooting, deployment operations, and strong coordination with engineering teams and clients. This role is highly technical and involves active participation in English-speaking client meetings and collaboration across multiple teams.


Responsibilities

  • Support the development team responsible for translating and adapting a distributed microservices e-commerce platform.
  • Manage and troubleshoot Kubernetes microservice deployments using Helm charts.
  • Operate and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines; diagnose and resolve failures in automated deployment processes.
  • Collaborate closely with Java and Python development teams to understand deployment requirements.
  • Troubleshoot client ecosystem tools based on Jenkins self-service pipelines.
  • Support backend technologies such as PostgreSQL and Kafka, handling configuration, connectivity, and integration issues.
  • Retrieve and analyze logs from Kubernetes pods and on-prem VMs using Grafana, ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), and Jenkins logs.
  • Participate in English-speaking client meetings to gather requirements, clarify needs, and provide updates.
  • Manage work using a Kanban workflow.
  • Contribute to improvements in deployment processes, documentation, monitoring, and troubleshooting procedures.


Required Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, and containerized deployments in on-premise environments.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, especially Jenkins.
  • Basic to intermediate experience with microservices written in Java and Python.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL and Kafka.
  • Ability to diagnose distributed system issues using logs, dashboards, and monitoring tools (Grafana, ELK, etc.).
  • Experience with on-premises infrastructure.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to participate confidently in English-speaking client meetings.
  • Experience with Agile/Kanban methodologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in complex environments.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting legacy systems built in Java.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with large enterprise e-commerce platforms.
  • Knowledge of networking, authentication, and authorization concepts.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash or Python.
  • Experience with Groovy for Jenkins Pipeline-as-Code.

The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Affiliate Administrator (LATAM, Remote)
description:
Ready to take your affiliate marketing expertise to the next level? Join GrowthAssistant as an Affiliate Administrator and play a pivotal role in leading the entire affiliate marketing process for a top U.S.-based agency. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a renowned brand while driving performance, managing partner communications, and ensuring campaigns run smoothly from start to finish.


You’ll be at the heart of strategic marketing efforts with a focus on accuracy, trend analysis, and client success—all while enjoying the flexibility of a remote setup, competitive pay, and great benefits.


Compensation & Perks

  • Salary Range: $6.00 – $7.50/hour (Final offer based on skills and experience matched to role requirements)
  • 100% permanent work-from-home
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) for Vacation and U.S. Holidays
  • $300 Referral Bonus for every successful candidate you refer
  • Performance-Based Bonuses
  • Year-End Bonus (client-initiated)
  • Perfect Attendance Bonus (for LATAM candidates)


What You’ll Do

  • Performance Reporting: Download and prepare performance reports using proprietary analytics tools for End of Week (EOW), End of Month (EOM), and End of Year (EOY) deliverables
  • Compliance Monitoring: Conduct weekly checks of affiliate sites for valid/invalid promotion codes and send templated emails to partners in violation
  • Outreach for Corrections: Send outbound templated emails to partners requesting corrections for compliance violations
  • BrandVerity Checks: Perform semi-weekly checks to monitor for trademark infringements and follow up with violators
  • KPI Oversight: Track daily client KPIs, compare results to defined guardrails, and flag discrepancies to the Account Manager
  • Monthly Recaps: Process monthly voids/edits and compile comprehensive recaps for internal review
  • Publisher Outreach: Assist in building publisher lists by researching contacts for provided publisher lists


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in affiliate marketing
  • Familiarity with Commission Junction or similar affiliate tools, and BrandVerity or similar platforms
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Intermediate proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and MS Office
  • Experience managing multiple clients or brands (a plus)
  • Highly organized, proactive, resourceful, and detail-oriented
  • Ability to work in any U.S. timezone or a night shift schedule in the Philippines


Why You’ll Love Working Here

At GrowthAssistant, you’ll collaborate with a diverse, talented team, sharpen your skills with global clients, and make an impact in affiliate marketing. We value your growth and recognize your contributions every step of the way.


Apply today and take the next step in your career with GrowthAssistant!

title: SAP ABAP Developer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $4,500 USD


Our partner has an immediate opening for a skilled SAP ABAP Programmer, Developer, and Consultant with a strong focus on Accounts Payable (FI-MM) and Document Management using SAP ArchiveLink and WebDAV.

This role offers the opportunity to work on innovative automation and document management solutions that enhance business efficiency and streamline enterprise workflows. The selected professional will join a collaborative, flexible environment where their expertise will directly contribute to delivering high-impact SAP solutions to clients.


Core Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and support custom SAP Document Management and automation solutions.
  • Program using ABAP (OO), applying strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Integrate technologies including SAP UI5, BTP, and REST APIs.
  • Build automation solutions around business processes within Accounts Payable (FI-MM) and other SAP modules, including SAP Workflow and AI-driven solutions.
  • Enhance and maintain our partner’s internal Suite of Products.
  • Participate in customer-facing activities such as demos, scoping calls, and post-deployment training.
  • Support existing customers using SAP ArchiveLink and related tools such as UiPath, Tungsten Automation (Kofax), ABBYY, and other intelligent automation/OCR platforms.
  • Collaborate with customers to gather technical specifications and deliver end-to-end deployments.
  • Develop and maintain ABAP add-ons with namespace version tracking; work with BADIs, enhancement frameworks, ABAP proxies, and web services.
  • Occasionally contribute to marketing material development.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field (or equivalent work experience).
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in SAP ABAP development, with demonstrated work in FI/MM modules.
  • Solid understanding of SAP ArchiveLink, Document Management Systems, and Accounts Payable processes.
  • Experience integrating SAP with automation and OCR platforms (UiPath, Kofax, ABBYY, etc.).
  • Proficiency in SAP UI5, Fiori, OData services, and REST APIs preferred.
  • Experience with SAP Workflow, BTP, and S/4HANA environments is a strong plus.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage directly with clients and stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a remote environment.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to work on cutting-edge SAP automation and document management solutions in a fully remote, collaborative environment.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Graphic Designer (Motion)
description:
We’re looking for a Graphic Designer with strong design fundamentals, an eye for storytelling, and the ability to bring visuals to life through motion. You’ll work across social content, digital graphics, brand design, presentations, and motion graphics.

This role is perfect for someone who loves blending design, animation, and smart use of modern tools and AI to create scroll-stopping, brand-aligned content. If you’re detail-oriented, enjoy working across formats, collaborate well with a creative team, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, you’ll fit right in.


What you'll do

  • Design high-quality social media creative, digital graphics, presentations, and branded visual systems across multiple formats and platforms.
  • Create motion graphics and animated elements — including transitions, text animations, graphics packages, and lightweight video edits for short-form content.
  • Apply brand guidelines consistently while finding space for creativity and innovation.
  • Use AI and modern creative tools to speed up ideation, design variations, motion workflows, and content exploration.
  • Collaborate with creative leads and project managers to clarify briefs, address feedback and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Maintain clean, organised files and a high standard of craft across motion and static work.


What you'll bring

  • 2+ years of experience as a Graphic Designer, Motion Designer, or hybrid creative role.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing brand design, social content, motion graphics, and layout expertise.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and strong working knowledge of Figma and presentation design tools.
  • Understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, colour systems, and brand identity.
  • Ability to animate and design for modern platforms (Reels, TikTok, YouTube, paid social, etc).
  • Familiarity with AI or automation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Runway and Midjourney).
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with tight timelines and evolving briefs.
  • A collaborative mindset, strong attention to detail, and an ability to embrace and act on feedback.
  • Clear and confident communication in English, with the ability to explain design decisions and collaborate effectively with both creatives and project managers.


Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency, and creativity. Our workflow is built for momentum — pairing great talent with streamlined processes, smart tech and a global, supportive team.


At SoCreative, you’ll have the chance to:

  • Work with ambitious brands across video, design, and motion formats.
  • Collaborate with world-class creatives around the globe.
  • Grow quickly in a company shaping how modern creative production works.
  • Take ownership of your work and contribute meaningfully to projects that move fast and have real impact.

description:

Job Summary

The Business Development Specialist will support two senior leaders within the organization while playing a key role in driving revenue growth, strengthening partner relationships, and ensuring smooth project and account management execution.

title: Responsable de Ouvidoria
description:
Estamos viviendo una etapa de rápido crecimiento.

Somos una de las startups más éxitos de México, y esto es solo el principio. Buscamos un Responsable de Ouvidoria con muchas ganas de impactar. Si quieres construir algo grande, este reto es para ti.


Objetivo:

Actuar como enlace institucional entre los usuarios/ciudadanos y la Compañía, mediante la recepción, análisis, tramitación y respuesta de manifestaciones (quejas, sugerencias, denuncias y solicitudes), garantizando derechos, promoviendo la mejora continua de los servicios ofrecidos y fortaleciendo la transparencia y el control social.


Responsabilidades clave:

  • Recibir, registrar, clasificar y tramitar las manifestaciones del público usuario conforme a los principios de la Ley No. 13.460/2017 (Ley de Derechos de los Usuarios) y demás normativa aplicable.
  • Emitir acuse de recibo y dar seguimiento a cada demanda, asegurando respuesta dentro de los plazos legales e internos establecidos.
  • Promover la resolución de conflictos entre usuarios y las áreas internas competentes, con independencia, imparcialidad y enfoque en el usuario.
  • Analizar de forma crítica las manifestaciones recibidas para identificar causas raíz, fallas sistémicas, riesgos operativos o brechas de cumplimiento.
  • Elaborar y presentar informes periódicos de gestión, estadísticas, indicadores y propuestas de mejora para alta dirección y Compliance.
  • Proteger la identidad de las partes denunciantes o solicitantes cuando corresponda, garantizando confidencialidad y manejo seguro de información sensible.
  • Orientar a los usuarios sobre el uso correcto de los canales de atención y sobre los procedimientos administrativos disponibles.
  • Promover acciones educativas internas y externas sobre derechos de los usuarios y mecanismos de participación.
  • Cooperar con órganos reguladores, auditorías y entes fiscalizadores cuando sea necesario.
  • Mantener actualizados los registros en el sistema electrónico de ouvidoría/gestión de demandas (p. ej., e-Ouv , cuando aplique).


Requisitos:

  • Titulación universitaria en Derecho, Administración Pública, Ciencias Sociales, Ciencias Políticas, Comunicación, u otras áreas afines.
  • Idiomas: Inglés - Español avanzado
  • 2- 5 años.
  • Mínimo 2 años en funciones similares , tales como atención a usuarios/clientes, control interno, compliance, auditoría, defensoría/ombudsperson u otros canales de servicio en industrias reguladas.
  • Experiencia en trato directo con usuarios, mediación de conflictos y redacción técnica/formal.



Habilidades técnicas

  • Conocimiento sólido de la Ley No. 13.460/2017 y del Decreto No. 9.492/2018 (o normativa equivalente sobre derechos de usuarios y canales de reclamación).
  • Familiaridad con normativas de protección de datos y derechos fundamentales (por ejemplo, LGPD , cuando aplique).
  • Manejo de herramientas o sistemas de gestión de quejas/tickets/ouvidoría.
  • Técnicas de mediación, análisis institucional y resolución de conflictos.
  • Indicadores de desempeño institucional y métricas de calidad de servicio.


Habilidades blandas

  • Ética e imparcialidad
  • Escucha activa y comunicación clara
  • Capacidad analítica y crítica
  • Sensibilidad social y orientación al usuario
  • Discreción y confidencialidad
  • Organización y gestión del tiempo
  • Trabajo colaborativo e influencia institucional

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Pleno I (PDV)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades:

  • Atuar com sustentação dos sistemas de PDV (TOTVS e Casa Magalhães) com foco em suportar as operações de lojas físicas;
  • Atuar, identificar e solucionar problemas de conectividade em lojas, avaliando equipamentos e link;
  • Acionar parceiros de conectividade quando necessário para reestabelecer serviços
  • Atuar, identificar e solucionar problemas de hardware nos PDVs das lojas;
  • Responsável por tratar os incidentes, sendo de software ou infra, das lojas de forma rápida e eficiente, seguindo os padrões definidos pelos parceiros internos e externos;
  • Atuar de forma proativa em lojas que apresentem sintomas de problemas em sua jornada de vendas;
  • Interpretar gráficos de alertas, quando indicadores saem do limite aceitável;
  • Negociar, envolver e buscar a integração do trabalho junto ao time de atendimento N1, garantindo sinergia, apoio e formação;
  • Responsável em manter a base de conhecimento e de procedimentos técnicos atualizada;


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em trabalhar com metodologia (ITIL e Framework Scrum);
  • Conhecimento ferramentas de gestão de TI, JIRA, TFS e Service NOW;
  • Conhecimento básico em scripts em powershell.
  • Conhecimento avançado em comandos de administração de sistema operacional Microsoft através de PowerShell ou prompt de comando;
  • Conhecimento avançado para suporte remoto em celulares Android e computadores windows;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de rede (TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP e afins);
  • Troubleshooting em ambientes Microsoft Windows 7, Windows 10 e Windows 11.


Modelo 100% remoto.

title: Seeking Local Partners in Industrial Manufacturing for Global Expansion
description:
Global Expansion Opportunity: Meta Smart Factory Is Seeking Local Partners in Industrial Manufacturing

Meta Smart Factory — a global leader in Smart Factory, MES, APS, AI, and Industrial Digitalization solutions — is expanding its international presence and is now seeking strong local partners in the industrial manufacturing domain.

If your company provides services to factories or operates within industrial automation, manufacturing consulting, IIoT, system integration, or digital transformation, this is a high-value partnership opportunity.

What We Offer

As a Meta Smart Factory partner, your company will earn through multiple revenue streams:

  • Software sales commissions (high-margin)
  • Annual maintenance & support income
  • Consultancy and implementation revenue
  • Long-term recurring business with global enterprise clients

Our partners gain access to a proven, scalable business model backed by cutting-edge solutions used across multiple sectors including automotive, food, plastics, metals, chemicals, packaging, and more.

Meta Smart Factory is rapidly growing with active operations in:

Turkey, Serbia, Saudi Arabia, Slovenia, South Africa, South Korea , and expanding across Europe, US, South America, the Middle East, Asia, and Africa.

  • IIoT & Machine Connectivity
  • Real-time Production Monitoring & KPI Systems
  • Full factory digital transformation for Industry 4.0 & 5.0

Our technologies are trusted by leading global manufacturers.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:

No 3rd Party C2Cs Please.


Location: Brazil, South America (work remote supporting US based client/project)

Employment Type: Contract Work, 40 hours weekly


100% Requirement: Must have good verbal & written communication (English)

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Developer. The project involves working with a tech-enabled healthcare organization: they build internal platforms to support physicians and other providers, as well as patient and partner-facing functionality. They are scaling virtual care across the country, using tech to drive high-quality patient outcomes.

  • Develop and implement full-stack features, with a primary focus on crafting intuitive and accessible frontend user experiences.

Nice to Have

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
As an AI Engineer at Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company), you will join a team of talented AI engineers to implement and deploy AI-driven solutions across various industries. You will be responsible for developing AI strategies, ensuring the successful execution of AI projects, and contribute to the development of AI tools and platforms. You will work closely with clients to understand their business needs, review and implement AI solution designs, and ensure that Acora remains at the forefront of AI innovation.


Key Responsibilities:

AI Solution Design & Development :

  • Join teams for development and implementation of AI solutions and systems for clients across various sectors.
  • Propose a broad spectrum of different ideas to complex problems, with the ability to quickly test and iterate to identify the best performing solution
  • Collaborate with Data Science, Cloud Engineering and UI designers and developers to design scalable, cloud-based AI architectures.
  • Stay ahead of the latest AI trends and technologies to continuously improve Acora’s AI offerings.

Client Engagement & Project Delivery :

  • Work with clients to understand their business challenges and objectives, translating them into AI-driven solutions.
  • Be a team player and help to ensure the timely and successful delivery of AI projects, maintaining high standards of quality, accuracy, and impact.
  • Be able to present AI strategies, solutions, and project outcomes to stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.
  • Nurture client relationships, whilst building credibility and trust through consistent high-quality delivery.

Operational Excellence :

  • Be part of the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of AI solutions, ensuring they perform reliably at scale.
  • Develop frameworks and processes to ensure AI models are robust, explainable, and aligned with regulatory standards.


Key Skills & Experience:

title: Creative Production Lead
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!

﻿

About Olly Olly

Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we're blending technology and real-world expertise to empower small businesses across the U.S. like never before.


We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That's why we're on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high-quality leads, get calls and reviews, and grow sustainably without the hassle.


The Olly Olly platform complements our hands-on service perfectly: it's no-nonsense, easy-to-use software that helps local businesses streamline operations, drive leads, and maximize revenue with minimal effort so they can focus on what they do best.


Why We Need You

You have the eye. You can look at a website for five seconds and know whether it builds trust or destroys it. You see the logo that looks like a 2008 Fiverr special, the stock photo that screams "we didn't try," the typography that signals cheap. And it bothers you. Physically.


We're building a production team that creates websites, logos, and visual assets for 4,000+ local service businesses—contractors, plumbers, attorneys, HVAC companies. These businesses live or die by how professional they look online. Your job is to make sure everything we ship makes them look like the best option in their market.


As Creative Production Lead , you'll manage a team of designers who assemble websites from content, photos, and structured data. You're not just assigning tickets. You're inspecting work daily, catching the details that kill credibility, coaching your team to see what you see, and refusing to let "good enough" out the door.


You can also DO the work yourself. When a logo needs to be created or fixed, you're not waiting for someone else. When a layout isn't working, you can open the file and make it better. You lead by example because you're a designer first, manager second.


The Impact You'll Have

  • Quality is your obsession. You review completed work daily—not for completion, but for excellence. You catch the weak logo, the amateur photo crop, the layout that buries the CTA, the color palette that feels dated. Nothing ships unless it meets your standards.
  • You inspect, you coach, you elevate. You're providing specific feedback on real work: "This logo doesn't work because the type is fighting the icon." "This hero image undermines trust—the lighting looks fake." "This layout guides the eye away from what matters." You're building your team's taste through detailed critiques.
  • You stay fluid. What looked great two years ago looks tired today. You're constantly studying what's working across industries, updating standards, killing approaches that stopped converting. When you spot a pattern that works, you train the team on it immediately.
  • You execute when needed. Logo needs a refresh? You can do it. Layout falling apart? You fix it. You're not above the work—you're the best at it.
  • You run production, not a gallery. This is high-volume. Your team handles hundreds of sites and thousands of updates monthly. You understand that speed and quality aren't opposites—they require discipline, systems, and people who give a damn.


What We Really Need From You

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years in visual design with a portfolio that demonstrates genuine taste—not just competence, but an eye for what converts vs. what just exists
  • 2+ years leading or managing a design team—you've held people to standards, given hard feedback, and developed talent
  • Hands-on execution skills: you can create and refine logos, fix layouts, improve visual hierarchy yourself
  • Production experience: you've worked in environments where volume mattered—agencies, e-commerce, high-output teams
  • Quality obsession: you reject work that's "fine" because fine doesn't win


What Would Be Big Pluses

  • Background in advertising, branding agencies, or e-commerce design
  • Experience with WordPress page builders (Elementor, WP Bakery, Divi, Gutenberg)—or willingness to learn fast
  • Understanding of conversion principles: what builds trust, what drives action
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems
  • Knowledge of SEO basics and how design choices impact performance


We'll teach you:

  • Our specific tools and workflows
  • WordPress/Elementor if you don't know them (you'll pick it up in a week)
  • Our brand guidelines and quality standards
  • The local service business landscape


What You'll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Salary: Competitive (based on experience and location)
  • Flexible work: 100% remote, core hours 8 AM – 5 PM EST for collaboration
  • Work-life balance: 15 vacation days + U.S. holidays
  • Growth path: This role leads to Director of Creative Production or VP of Creative. You'll build the team, the systems, and the culture.
  • Real impact: Your standards directly determine whether 17,000+ small businesses look like winners or also-rans.


Why Choose Us?

We're evolving from template-driven agency work to genuinely differentiated design. You'll build a team culture where craft matters, where mediocrity gets rejected, and where the work actually helps small businesses compete.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here—and your unique perspective helps us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Regulatory Officer - Agrochemicals - Relocate to Europe
description:
Regulatory Officer - Agrochemical Sector (International Scope)
 Location: Netherlands (Relocation Support & Visa Sponsorship Provided)

Are you an experienced regulatory professional with a passion for plant science, compliance, and international markets? A global player in the agrochemical and crop protection sector , headquartered in the Netherlands , is seeking an experienced Regulatory Officer to join their team.

This is a permanent, full-time position based in the Netherlands , and the employer offers full visa sponsorship and relocation support for the right candidate.

About the Role

In this pivotal position, you will be responsible for managing the full life-cycle of regulatory affairs, including product registration, dossier submission, and coordination of field and lab trials for a wide portfolio of products such as pesticides, fungicides, herbicides, biopesticides, plant nutrients, and veterinary products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead all activities related to product registration and regulatory compliance across multiple regions (particularly Latin America, Africa, India, and China).

  • Oversee field trial operations and coordinate toxicological and ecotoxicological research across international laboratories.

  • Prepare, edit, and submit registration dossiers to agricultural and health authorities.

  • Represent the company in regulatory committees, as well as in discussions with suppliers and customers.

  • Support patent submissions and the company's regulatory strategy.

  • Ensure progress and compliance of all registration projects in alignment with local legislation.

Your Profile

  • Master's degree or higher in Bioengineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Biology, or a related scientific discipline.

  • Minimum of 8 years' experience in regulatory affairs for pesticides, particularly in Latin America and Africa .

  • At least 3 years' experience working with GLP and non-GLP laboratories

  • Strong analytical skills and a methodical, accurate working style.

  • Excellent project management and communication skills.

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); knowledge of Spanish, Indian or Chinese is a plus.

  • Proficient with MS Office tools.

What's on Offer

  • A dynamic, international role within a growing agrochemical company based in the Netherlands.

  • Full visa sponsorship and relocation support for international applicants.

  • A cooperative, multidisciplinary work environment with significant responsibility and independence.

  • Opportunities for international travel and direct engagement with global regulatory bodies.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Intermediate proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and MS Office
  • Experience managing multiple clients or brands (a plus)
  • Highly organized, proactive, resourceful, and detail-oriented

title: Responsable de Ouvidoria
description:
Estamos viviendo una etapa de rápido crecimiento.

Somos una de las startups más éxitos de México, y esto es solo el principio. Buscamos un Responsable de Ouvidoria con muchas ganas de impactar. Si quieres construir algo grande, este reto es para ti.


Objetivo:

Actuar como enlace institucional entre los usuarios/ciudadanos y la Compañía, mediante la recepción, análisis, tramitación y respuesta de manifestaciones (quejas, sugerencias, denuncias y solicitudes), garantizando derechos, promoviendo la mejora continua de los servicios ofrecidos y fortaleciendo la transparencia y el control social.


Responsabilidades clave:

  • Recibir, registrar, clasificar y tramitar las manifestaciones del público usuario conforme a los principios de la Ley No. 13.460/2017 (Ley de Derechos de los Usuarios) y demás normativa aplicable.
  • Emitir acuse de recibo y dar seguimiento a cada demanda, asegurando respuesta dentro de los plazos legales e internos establecidos.
  • Promover la resolución de conflictos entre usuarios y las áreas internas competentes, con independencia, imparcialidad y enfoque en el usuario.
  • Analizar de forma crítica las manifestaciones recibidas para identificar causas raíz, fallas sistémicas, riesgos operativos o brechas de cumplimiento.
  • Elaborar y presentar informes periódicos de gestión, estadísticas, indicadores y propuestas de mejora para alta dirección y Compliance.
  • Proteger la identidad de las partes denunciantes o solicitantes cuando corresponda, garantizando confidencialidad y manejo seguro de información sensible.
  • Orientar a los usuarios sobre el uso correcto de los canales de atención y sobre los procedimientos administrativos disponibles.
  • Promover acciones educativas internas y externas sobre derechos de los usuarios y mecanismos de participación.
  • Cooperar con órganos reguladores, auditorías y entes fiscalizadores cuando sea necesario.
  • Mantener actualizados los registros en el sistema electrónico de ouvidoría/gestión de demandas (p. ej., e-Ouv , cuando aplique).


Requisitos:

  • Titulación universitaria en Derecho, Administración Pública, Ciencias Sociales, Ciencias Políticas, Comunicación, u otras áreas afines.
  • Idiomas: Inglés - Español avanzado
  • 2- 5 años.
  • Mínimo 2 años en funciones similares , tales como atención a usuarios/clientes, control interno, compliance, auditoría, defensoría/ombudsperson u otros canales de servicio en industrias reguladas.
  • Experiencia en trato directo con usuarios, mediación de conflictos y redacción técnica/formal.



Habilidades técnicas

  • Conocimiento sólido de la Ley No. 13.460/2017 y del Decreto No. 9.492/2018 (o normativa equivalente sobre derechos de usuarios y canales de reclamación).
  • Familiaridad con normativas de protección de datos y derechos fundamentales (por ejemplo, LGPD , cuando aplique).
  • Manejo de herramientas o sistemas de gestión de quejas/tickets/ouvidoría.
  • Técnicas de mediación, análisis institucional y resolución de conflictos.
  • Indicadores de desempeño institucional y métricas de calidad de servicio.


Habilidades blandas

  • Ética e imparcialidad
  • Escucha activa y comunicación clara
  • Capacidad analítica y crítica
  • Sensibilidad social y orientación al usuario
  • Discreción y confidencialidad
  • Organización y gestión del tiempo
  • Trabajo colaborativo e influencia institucional

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Ecommerce Growth Consulting & Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses attract, engage, and convert their ideal audience.

Our Mission: to help DTC ecommerce companies grow holistically

Our Vision: We imagine a world where service businesses never have to worry about meeting revenue goals, attracting consistent quality customers, retaining customers, or maintaining and growing their overall online presence.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated

- Pay close attention to detail 

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator

- Confidence and determination to achieve our vision.


Who We Are Looking For:


We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.


The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.


The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.


Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
  • Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
  • Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
  • Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
  • Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
  • Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
  • Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.


Compensation:

  • $2000 - $5000 USD per month

title: Pricing Specialist
description:
About Us

We are a growing freight brokerage and transportation company specializing in time-sensitive, temperature-controlled, and high-touch shipments across the U.S. We work with shippers in industries such as medical, artwork, hazmat, and white-glove services, and we pride ourselves on being responsive, reliable, and solutions-oriented.

We’re looking for a Pricing Specialist to own our day-to-day quoting and pricing strategy, helping us win profitable freight while maintaining strong carrier relationships.


Key Responsibilities

Spot & Contract Pricing

  • Prepare spot quotes for truckload, LTL, reefer, flatbed, and specialty shipments in a fast-paced environment.
  • Analyze customer RFQs/RFPs and build competitive, profitable pricing proposals.
  • Maintain and update pricing matrices, lane guides, and rate tables.

Market & Lane Analysis

  • Monitor daily market conditions (capacity, seasonality, fuel, regional trends) and adjust pricing accordingly.
  • Analyze historical data by lane, customer, and mode to set target margins and identify opportunities.
  • Recommend pricing strategies for new lanes, customers, and verticals.

Collaboration with Sales & Operations

  • Partner with the sales team to support new business opportunities and respond quickly to customer quote requests.
  • Work closely with carrier procurement/operations to understand true cost on lanes, including repositioning, deadhead, and accessorial.
  • Provide clear pricing logic and talking points so the sales team can confidently present rates to customers.

Margin & Performance Management

  • Track win rates, margins, and quote response times, and suggest improvements based on data.
  • Flag unprofitable lanes and customers and propose revised pricing or alternative solutions.
  • Build and maintain dashboards or reports for leadership (e.g., by lane, mode, customer).
  • Tools & Process Improvement
  • Use TMS, load boards, and market data tools to benchmark rates and build accurate quotes.
  • Help refine internal pricing workflows, templates, and SLAs to speed up response times and improve accuracy.


Requirements

Experience

  • 2–5+ years of pricing, carrier procurement, or operations experience in a freight brokerage or 3PL environment.
  • Strong understanding of truckload and/or LTL pricing, including fuel, accessorial, detention, and layover.

Skills

  • Strong English communication skills (writing and speaking) are required. Day-to-day work and communication with our team and customers is in English.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (lookups, pivot tables, basic modeling).
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into clear pricing recommendations.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • High sense of urgency and ability to handle a high volume of quote requests with tight deadlines.

Other

  • Must be based in Colombia, Brazil, Argentina, or Mexico (or nearby LATAM country with similar time zone).
  • Comfortable working remotely and independently, with accountability for results.
  • Able to on Eastern Time hours.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with major TMS platforms and load boards (e.g., DAT, Truckstop, etc.).
  • Prior exposure to temperature-controlled, white glove, hazmat, or airport/air freight-related freight.
  • Experience responding to large RFPs or managing contract bids for enterprise customers.


What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary in USD plus performance-based bonus.
  • Fully remote role
  • Opportunity to help shape the pricing strategy of a growing brokerage.
  • Collaborative team culture that values responsiveness, ownership, and continuous improvement.


How to Apply

Please apply directly on LinkedIn or send your resume in English to   with the subject line:

 “Pricing Specialist – LATAM (Your Name)”

In your message, please include:

  • Your country & city of residence
  • Your current or most recent monthly salary
  • Your expected monthly salary inHow to Apply USD
  • A brief note on your experience with freight brokerage/freight forwarding pricing
  • Your English level (e.g., B2, C1, native)

title: assessor pedagogico
description:
PESSOA ASSESSORA PEDAGOGICA SR - BAHIA/BA (Mercado Público)

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar dando apoio pedagógico em Secretarias Municipais e Regionais Estaduais de Ensino.

Atendimento externo na Região de Atendimento: Estado do Bahia.

  • Desenvolvimento de Relacionamento Institucional: Estabelecer e manter uma comunicação eficaz com as instituições (SMEs, DEs e escolas) para entender suas necessidades e construir parcerias sólidas.
  • Formação Continuada: Planejar e realizar capacitações pedagógicas para equipes gestoras e docentes, visando aprimorar metodologias e práticas em sala de aula.
  • Acompanhamento e Planejamento de Ações: Monitorar o trabalho desenvolvido pelas instituições, utilizando a análise de dados para identificar pontos de melhoria e planejar intervenções formativas personalizadas.
  • Gestão de Informações e Documentação: Manter registros precisos das ações realizadas em ferramentas específicas da empresa, garantindo a transparência e a organização dos processos.
  • Apresentação de Obras e Serviços Educacionais: Atuar como um elo entre a empresa e as redes de ensino, divulgando e apresentando as soluções educacionais disponíveis quando solicitado.
  • Gestão Contratual e de Projetos: Planejar, organizar e acompanhar a execução das ações previstas em contratos de Soluções Educacionais, assegurando o cumprimento das horas contratadas e das metas estabelecidas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Licenciatura em qualquer área.
  • Pós-Graduação: Na área de Educação (preferencial).
  • Atuação prévia em escolas como professor e/ou coordenador pedagógico ou de área.
  • Preferencialmente, experiência na Rede Pública de Ensino.
  • Experiência com formação de professores.
  • Domínio de leis, diretrizes e normas que regem o sistema educacional brasileiro (BNCC, LDB, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ativas, tecnologias educacionais, avaliação formativa e outras tendências da área.
  • Domínio do pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)
  • Relacionamento Interpessoal: Diálogo, Colaboração, Empatia, Trabalho em equipe.
  • Execução e Resultados: Entrega, Responsabilidade, Integridade.
  • Estratégia e Inovação: Visão estratégica, Criatividade, Adaptabilidade.
  • Disponibilidade integral para viagens (Obrigatório).
  • CNH (Carteira Nacional de Habilitação) requerida (Obrigatório).
  • Preferência de moradia: Bahia e região metropolitana ou cidades-polo da Bahia.

Salário mensal: R$6.180,3

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

title: Tax Analyst
description:

title: Safety, Environment & Healthy Coordinator
description:
Somos PepsiCo

Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados(as) com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.

Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER, TODDY, TODDYNHO, ELMA CHIPS, RUFFLES, DORITOS, EQLIBRI TM, GATORADE, KERO COCO, H2OH!, PEPSI e muitas outras.

Uma carreira na PepsiCo significa trabalhar em uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Aqui, você pode ousar ser você. Não importa quem você seja, de onde você venha ou quem você ame, você sempre pode influenciar as pessoas ao seu redor e causar um impacto positivo no mundo.

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs

A oportunidade

Garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro e saudável para todos os colaboradores da planta de Feira de Santana (locais administrativos, Manufatura, Warehouse e etc.), atendendo a conformidade com todas as regulamentações ambientais e de saúde e segurança relacionadas à unidade, incluindo a implementação de políticas, procedimentos e sistema de gestão interno que visam prevenir acidentes, lesões ocupacionais e impactos ambientais.

Garantir o cumprimento dos objetivos, metas e indicadores definidos pela Pepsico e definir estratégias de atuação para a área e desenvolvimento da equipe.

O seu impacto

- Garantir o cumprimento da Política de Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança (SSMA) estabelecida;

- Liderar a equipe local de EHS;

- Garantir o cumprimento das normas locais, estaduais e federais de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente;

- Desenvolver e implementar programas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente;

- Identificar e avaliar os riscos associados às operações da planta e do armazém, incluindo análises de risco de processo;

- Fornecer suporte e treinamento relacionados a EHS;

- Investigar incidentes de segurança, acidentes de trabalho e eventos ambientais para determinar as causas e implementar medidas de controle;

- Liderar a implementação e manutenção do sistema de gestão interno na fábrica;

- Gerenciar riscos e minimizar impactos relacionados às atividades, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e novas tecnologias e compartilhar as melhores práticas;

- Liderar inspeções e acompanhar visitas técnicas, inspeções e auditorias de órgãos públicos;

- Recomendar medidas de controle quanto ao grau de exposição a agentes agressivos de natureza física, química e biológica, caracterizando atividades, operações e locais insalubres e perigosos;

- Analisar e liderar a gestão de mudanças para instalações, máquinas, equipamentos e projetos da área de Engenharia;

- Especificar, controlar e supervisionar, garantindo a qualidade e a eficiência dos sistemas de proteção coletiva e Equipamentos de Segurança, incluindo equipamentos de proteção individual e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio;

- Interagir ativamente junto aos Comitês Técnicos, principalmente liderando os programas sistêmicos visando a garantia das execuções;

- Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia durante o planejamento e execução de projetos de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente;

- Governar e gerenciar os indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) de EHS, criar planos para melhoria contínua e conformidade;

- Gerenciar o orçamento e o planejamento estratégico da área (Budget);

- Gestão do AOP (Annual Operating Plan);

- Desenvolver e apresentar os resultados de EHS à liderança e à operação;

- Implementar práticas e tecnologias sustentáveis para minimizar o impacto ambiental da operação da planta;

- Gerenciar o licenciamento da planta;

- Colaborar com outras áreas, como produção, manutenção e qualidade, para garantir a integração efetiva das práticas de EHS em todas as atividades;

- Conduzir campanhas, comunicações e programas de conscientização de EHS;

- Manter contato com agências reguladoras e acompanhar atividades de inspeção e fiscalização.

Quem estamos buscando?

  • Graduação em Engenharia com especialização em Engenharia de Segurança e Meio Ambiente;
  • Experiência sólida como líder em Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança (SSMA);
  • Sólido conhecimento do sistema de gestão de SSMA;
  • Auditor líder em ISO 14001, ISO 45001 e suas aplicabilidades;
  • Sólido conhecimento das regulamentações atuais de SSMA;
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de talentos;
  • Habilidade desenvolvida em gerenciar dados e estatísticas de SSMA;
  • Habilidades eficazes de networking em uma região multinacional, multifuncional e com múltiplas unidades de negócios;
  • Idiomas: Inglês (experiente), Espanhol (experiente) desejável.
  • Expertise em plataformas de gestão de Requisitos Legais (ex. Sistema IUS Natura);
  • Auditor líder em sistemas de gestão de EHS;

Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção; ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).
  • Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbri o para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.
  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.
  • Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.
  • E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.

Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. Oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades e consideramos os(as) candidatos(as) para todos os cargos, sem distinção de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
  • Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
  • Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Superior completo em Arquitetura, hotelaria ou turismo;
  • Domínio dos softwares AutoCAD e SketchUp;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Power BI será um diferencial;
  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas à gestão da qualidade e atendimento em shopping centers ou em setores similares;
  • Conhecimento de regulamentações e normas de segurança e qualidade.

Local de Trabalho: Boulevard Shopping Feira de Santana

Escala: Trabalha 5 dias e folga 2

title: Jefe De Planeamiento Supply Chain
description:
Empresa con gran trayectoria y de alcance internacional, se encuentra en la búsqueda de un talento:


Jefe de Planeamiento y Demanda


¿Cuál es la Misión del puesto?


  • Liderar, integrar y hacer eficientes los procesos implicados en la cadena de suministro como son: estimación de la demanda, planificación de la cadena de abastecimiento, compras estratégicas, operaciones de planta y logística y transporte, lo cual implica una interacción y coordinación de acciones constante con los distintos referentes de áreas.
  • Definir el plan de demanda, plan de abastecimiento a los COs, producción y abastecimiento de materias primas e insumos, liderando a su equipo para que se realice de acuerdo a lo acordado.
  • Liderar los planes Estratégicos y planes de mediano y corto plazo de su área, así como liderar y desarrollar a su equipo en pos de la incorporación de prácticas modernas de Planeamiento.
  • Plantear los objetivos del área en forma alineada con los objetivos de la Gerencia de Supply Chain y la Gerencia Corporativa.
  • Liderar y acompañar en la mejora continua del portafolio de la compañía a través del Proceso de Racionalización de SKUs (Cure & Kill) a partir de comités multifuncionales con los diversos actores a lo largo de la Cadena de Suministro.
  • Coordinar con las áreas de la compañía las tareas de limpieza de datos y mejora de procesos de ciclo de vida del producto.
  • Asegurar que no se tengan quiebres a través del correcto balance de producción y abastecimiento a COs oportunamente.
  • Velar por el Working Capital de la compañía a través de la administración de los inventarios de PT, MP y Repuestos.
  • Contribuir y velar por el buen clima laboral, coordinando y participando en las diferentes actividades que se desarrollen en coordinación con las otras jefaturas de la empresa.
  • Cumplir con las políticas y lineamientos de la empresa, del sistema integrado de gestión, política de las 5S, el RIT y el código de ética, así como del marco normativo del gobierno con la finalidad de contribuir con el desarrollo óptimo y adecuado de las diferentes actividades de la organización.


¿Cuáles son los requisitos del puesto?


  • Titulado en Administración, Ingeniería Industriasl o carreras afines.
  • Contar con 3 años de experiencia viendo procesos S&OP y manejo de presupuesto. (Indispensable)
  • Conocimiento en SAP y Office (Indispensable)
  • Nivel de inglés Intermedio/avanzado (Deseable).
  • Conocimientos en gestión de procesos, gestión por competencia y gestión al cambio.


¿Qué te ofrecemos?


  • Formar parte de una empresa líder en su sector.
  • Planilla Completa.

title: Gerente De Vendas
description:
About the job


1. About Us


We are a leading global technology company operating in the high-growth sector of On-Demand Consumer Services . Leveraging innovative technology and proven strategies from a global digital commerce leader, we are driving massive international expansion. We offer a challenging, fast-paced environment and an unparalleled opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up in new markets.


2. Responsibilities


  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist our organization in establishing a local sales team , building from scratch to drive business expansion. Rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals through systematic one-on-one and group training models.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth internal and external communication channels. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building : Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
